detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Symbiotic Civilization framework—a post-anthropocentric paradigm integrating planetary cognition, Indigenous knowledge, and systems science to operationalize regenerative intelligence at the planetary scale. Synthesizing insights from over two hundred peer-reviewed studies across ecology, economics, and cognitive science, the study merges Indigenous ecological epistemologies (Kimmerer, 2013; Nelson & Shilling, 2018) with research in planetary cognition (Frank et al., 2022; Haqq-Misra et al., 2024) and post-growth economics (Hickel, 2020; Raworth, 2018). It identifies twelve modes of Symbiotic Design across material, adaptive, and regenerative domains. These modes are translated into measurable indices—the Material Regeneration Index (MRI), Adaptive Intelligence Index (AII), and Relational Coherence Score (RCS)—which together form the composite Planetary Coherence Index (PCI), quantifying civilization’s alignment with Earth’s autopoietic intelligence. Three testable hypotheses link biogenic design principles, pluriversal governance models, and autopoietic feedback systems with measurable improvements in resilience and ecological balance. Advancing beyond regeneration toward coherence and, ultimately, symbiosis, the framework positions civilization as a distributed organ of Earth’s cognitive metabolism and establishes a pathway toward a Planetary Symbiosis Index (PSI)—a next-generation metric of planetary participation and mutual flourishing. This is the first framework to quantify civilization’s contribution to planetary cognition through measurable indices of material, adaptive, and relational coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了共生文明框架，这是一个后人类中心主义范式，整合了行星认知、原住民知识和系统科学，旨在实现行星尺度的再生智能。该研究综合了200多篇生态学、经济学和认知科学领域的同行评审研究，将原住民生态认识论与行星认知和后增长经济学研究相结合，识别出12种共生设计模式，并开发了可测量的指数来量化文明与地球自创生智能的对齐程度。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够量化文明对行星认知贡献的后人类中心主义框架？
AI.motivation: 超越再生，向共生和一致性发展，将文明定位为地球认知代谢的分布式器官，建立通往行星共生指数的路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共生文明框架，整合行星认知、原住民知识（Kimmerer, 2013; Nelson & Shilling, 2018）、系统科学和后增长经济学（Hickel, 2020; Raworth, 2018）。
AI.method: 综合200多篇同行评审研究，识别12种共生设计模式，开发可测量指数（材料再生指数、适应智能指数、关系一致性分数、行星一致性指数）。
AI.findings: 建立了首个通过可测量指数量化文明对行星认知贡献的框架，提出了三个可检验假设，将生物设计原则、多元治理模型和自创生反馈系统与可测量的韧性和生态平衡改善联系起来。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了后人类中心主义的共生文明范式，将文明概念化为地球认知代谢的分布式器官，建立了行星共生指数的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可操作化的测量工具（MRI、AII、RCS、PCI），为评估文明与地球智能的对齐程度提供了实用指标，为政策制定和治理提供了指导框架。

title: Spatio-Temporal Shifts in War Terminology
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Spatio-Temporal Shifts in War Terminology
detail.abstract: One of the reasons for arguments is the objective definition of words. A deeper problem arises when people define words differently across space and time, leading to significant discursive tensions. For example, the word "terrorist" demonstrates a drastic shift in meaning over time. During the French Revolution in the late 18th century, the term was used to describe state agents who used violence to maintain order and control. By the 19th century, the term began to refer to non-state actors using violence against governments. In the modern era, especially after the events of 9/11, "terrorist" refers almost exclusively to non-state actors targeting civilians. Similarly, the term "coloniser" is far from neutral: from a Palestinian standpoint, colonisation is rooted in the post-1967 occupation of the West Bank, East Jerusalem, and Gaza, whereas other framings project legitimacy backwards to earlier periods, selectively invoking history to define who 'first' belongs. Meanwhile, others, especially those supporting Israel, frame their perspective through a much earlier historical lens, dating back to around 1200 BCE to 70 CE, when ancient Jewish kingdoms such as Israel and Judah existed in the land historically known as Canaan or Judea. In this context, the term "return" is used instead of "colonisation," reflecting a belief in an ancestral right to the land. By placing the same conflict within different time frames, both sides use historical narratives to validate their claims. This illustrates how the use of language involves various dimensions of time and space, generating semantic and political conflict. This paper analyses how the shifting definitions of terms, along with their manipulation and contestation, contribute to misunderstandings, bias, and politicised narratives in media representations of wars.

AI.tldr: 本文分析词语定义在时空变化中如何导致语义冲突，特别是"恐怖分子"和"殖民者"等词汇在不同历史时期和立场下的定义差异，以及这些定义变化如何影响媒体对战争报道的理解偏差和政治化叙事。
AI.research_question: 词语定义的时空变化如何导致语义冲突，并影响媒体对战争报道的理解偏差和政治化叙事？
AI.motivation: 词语定义在不同时空背景下的变化常常导致理解偏差和政治冲突，特别是在战争报道中，这种定义差异会强化对立立场，影响公众对冲突的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语义学理论、话语分析理论、政治传播理论、历史叙事理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过"恐怖分子"和"殖民者"等关键术语的历史演变和不同立场定义进行对比分析
AI.findings: 词语定义具有时空依赖性，同一术语在不同历史时期和不同立场下具有截然不同的含义；历史叙事的选择性使用强化了政治立场的对立；语言的时间维度运用是政治话语的重要策略
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对语言时空维度的理解，提出了词语定义的政治性分析框架，拓展了语义冲突理论在政治传播中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体从业者提供语言使用的反思工具，帮助公众识别政治话语中的定义操纵，促进对冲突报道的批判性理解

title: Jornadas comunitarias inspiradoras de las estrategias de formación en las escuelas de negocios virtuosas (Community working days inspiring teaching strategies in virtuous business schools)
affiliations: Universidad Iberoamericana Puebla

detail.title: Jornadas comunitarias inspiradoras de las estrategias de formación en las escuelas de negocios virtuosas (Community working days inspiring teaching strategies in virtuous business schools)
detail.abstract:
Spanish Abstract: Esta investigación revisa las estrategias de aprendizaje, tradicionalmente empleadas en las escuelas, facultades o departamentos para la enseñanza de los negocios o la administración de empresas, identificando aquellos cambios que pudieran garantizar una formación virtuosa de su alumnado acorde con las realidades regionales y con las posibilidades de incidir en la ruralidad. El propósito fundamental consiste en descubrir las formas como la comunidad estudiantil de licenciatura puede incidir rural y socialmente dejando de lado, por un momento, la idea de las finalidades lucrativas, para concentrarse en las necesidades de las comunidades agropecuarias. Para ello, y con ocasión de una serie de visitas del estudiantado de siete licenciaturas relacionadas con los negocios, a tres localidades poblanas, se explora mediante cuestionario aquellos rasgos de carácter que pudieran reforzarse y asimilarse en sus procesos formativos. Se encontró, por un lado, potencial y disposición del alumnado para la apropiación de rasgos tendientes a la búsqueda del bien común, y por otro, la urgente necesidad de ajustar los contenidos de algunas asignaturas. Hay que decirlo, entre la población estudiada se percibieron rasgos de arrogancia, soberbia y egoísmo, que a todas luces constituyen el opuesto de virtudes como humildad, altruismo e interés común. Y es que persiste, en la población estudiantil de negocios, la idea de que todas las actividades en aula y fuera de ella, tienen que ver con la licenciatura estudiada y por tanto, las aproximaciones a la población vulnerable no son de su competencia. Palabras clave: relación universidad comunidad, valores éticos, virtudes, formación profesional superior.

English Abstract: This research reviews the learning strategies traditionally used at schools, faculties or departments to teach either business or administration. We identify those changes that could contribute to the virtuous formation of their students according to regional realities and with possibilities to impact on rurality. The main purpose is discovering those ways undergraduate students could impact rurally and socially, putting aside for a moment, the idea of lucrative purposes, and instead of that focalize the agricultural community’s needs. To achieve this and framed in a set of students’ visits to three Puebla rural locations we applied a questionary about main virtues to teach and to assimilate in their formative processes. Findings show, first, that there is a potential and will of students to acquire character traits tending to the common good, and second, it is urgent to adjust some subjects’ contents. It is important to recognize that some students exhibited some traits of hubris, arrogance and selfishness, that obviously are the opposite of virtues such as humbleness, altruism and common wellbeing. This is because in the student community there is a belief that all activities both in the classroom and extracurricular activities must be related to their undergraduate program, so all kinds of approaching activities to the vulnerable population are not their responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨商科教育中如何通过调整学习策略来培养学生美德，重点关注学生对农村社区的社会影响。研究发现学生具备追求共同利益的潜力，但也存在傲慢、自私等问题，需要调整课程内容。
AI.research_question: 商科本科生如何通过调整学习策略来对农村社区产生社会影响，而不仅仅是追求营利目的？
AI.motivation: 传统商科教育过于注重营利目的，忽视了学生美德培养和对农村社区的社会责任，需要探索符合区域现实的教育策略。

AI.method: 通过问卷调查，对访问普埃布拉三个农村社区的七个商科专业本科生进行研究。

title: Overconfident CEOs and Corporate Trademarking
affiliations: Singapore University of Social Sciences, Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics and Colorado State University, Fort Collins - Department of Finance & Real Estate

detail.title: Overconfident CEOs and Corporate Trademarking
detail.abstract: This research examines the impact of chief executive officer (CEO) overconfidence on firms’ trademarking activities reflected in new trademark registrations. The authors hypothesize that firms with overconfident CEOs register a higher number of new trademarks. The positive relation strengthens in firms in advertising-dependent industries, firms facing more intensive product market competition, or in industries with higher business uncertainties, and firms led by more capable CEOs. Moreover, firms led by overconfident CEOs are more likely to pursue trademarks in new product categories and to adopt distinctive new brand names, reflecting a preference for higher-risk trademarking strategies. Trademarks registered by firms led by overconfident CEOs demonstrate higher brand impacts and greater market value. Using a sample of S&P 1500 firms from 1993 to 2015, the authors find evidence supporting their hypotheses. The authors also explore changes in firms’ trademarking activities around exogenous CEO turnovers and find evidence consistent with their conjecture. These findings uncover the role of executives’ personal traits in influencing how firms leverage trademarks to support product innovation and brand development, offering a novel pathway through which leaders contribute to firm value.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨CEO过度自信对企业商标注册活动的影响。研究发现，过度自信的CEO会注册更多新商标，特别是在广告依赖型行业、竞争激烈或不确定性高的行业中。这些CEO更倾向于采用高风险商标策略，其注册的商标具有更高的品牌影响力和市场价值。
AI.research_question: CEO过度自信如何影响企业的商标注册活动？
AI.motivation: 探索高管个人特质如何影响企业通过商标支持产品创新和品牌发展的方式，揭示领导者贡献企业价值的新途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: CEO过度自信理论、行为公司金融理论、商标战略理论
AI.method: 使用1993-2015年S&P 1500企业样本，分析CEO过度自信与商标注册的关系，并通过外生CEO更替进行验证。
AI.findings: 过度自信CEO的企业注册更多新商标，更可能在新产品类别注册商标并采用独特新品牌名称，这些商标具有更高品牌影响力和市场价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高管个人特质在商标战略中的作用，拓展了行为公司金融理论在知识产权管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业理解CEO特质对品牌战略的影响提供指导，帮助投资者评估企业商标价值创造潜力。

title: On the Proper Treatment of Normalized Statistical Moments as Coordinates in Hamiltonian Phase Space: A Methodological Note for Empirical Diagnostics

detail.title: On the Proper Treatment of Normalized Statistical Moments as Coordinates in Hamiltonian Phase Space: A Methodological Note for Empirical Diagnostics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: We consider Hamiltonian diagnostics built on the empirical first four moments of a financial return distribution, using mean, standard deviation, skewness, and kurtosis as phase-space coordinates. A common (and seductive) implementation scales all coordinates by recent empirical dispersion to produce a "dimensionless" chart. We show this "double-normalisation" is inappropriate for already-normalised shape descriptors (skewness and kurtosis). It induces spurious curvature in the potential energy of an otherwise linear Hamiltonian, leading to explosive energies in quiet windows. We formalise the pathology, provide a principled construction that treats dimensional and dimensionless coordinates differently, and demonstrate empirically that the corrected model yields stable, interpretable energy partitions that cleanly distinguish trend from trap regimes. This methodological note addresses a gap at the intersection of Hamiltonian moment hierarchies (typically applied to raw moments in plasma physics) and statistical diagnostics (which employ pre-normalized shape descriptors).

AI.tldr: 本文指出在金融回报分布的哈密顿诊断中，对已标准化的形状描述符（偏度和峰度）进行二次归一化是不恰当的，会导致虚假的势能曲率和能量爆炸。作者提出了一个原则性的构建方法，区分处理维度和无量纲坐标，并证明修正后的模型能产生稳定、可解释的能量划分。
AI.research_question: 在金融回报分布的哈密顿诊断中，如何正确处理已标准化的形状描述符（偏度和峰度）以避免虚假的势能曲率和能量爆炸？
AI.motivation: 当前实践中对偏度和峰度等已标准化的形状描述符进行二次归一化（"双归一化"）的做法是不恰当的，这会导致哈密顿系统中的虚假势能曲率和在平静窗口中出现爆炸性能量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈密顿力学框架，结合金融回报分布的前四阶矩（均值、标准差、偏度、峰度）作为相空间坐标。
AI.method: 形式化分析双归一化方法的病理学，提供原则性的构建方法，区分处理维度和无量纲坐标，并进行实证演示。
AI.findings: 双归一化方法会导致虚假的势能曲率和能量爆炸，而修正后的模型能产生稳定、可解释的能量划分，清晰区分趋势和陷阱机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了哈密顿矩层次结构（通常应用于等离子体物理中的原始矩）和统计诊断（使用预归一化的形状描述符）交叉领域的方法论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融风险管理和市场状态识别提供了更稳定、更准确的哈密顿诊断工具，能够清晰区分市场趋势和陷阱状态。

title: Equal Treatment as Acknowledgment: A Legislative Response to Gender-Affirming Care Restrictions in Michigan
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Equal Treatment as Acknowledgment: A Legislative Response to Gender-Affirming Care Restrictions in Michigan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author drafted the legislation presented in this Article as part of an independent civic research project developing a constitutional physiology framework: an approach that understands law as a system designed to maintain dignity, proportionality, and homeostasis in the civic body. The author has no financial stake in the outcome of this proposal and receives no institutional funding or organizational support. This work is submitted solely to advance equitable access to medically necessary care for minors under existing civil rights law.

detail.abstract:
This Article presents the Michigan Youth Dignity in Medicine Act, a state-level legislative model designed to restore medical parity for transgender minors in Michigan. Under the state’s civil rights law (ELCRA), public accommodations — including hospitals — may not discriminate on the basis of gender identity. Yet several Michigan hospital systems have suspended gender-affirming care for minors while continuing to use the exact same puberty blockers, hormone therapies, and clinical protocols for cisgender minors with other medical indications. This selective denial is not medically grounded; it is an identity-based exclusion that violates both established clinical standards and the Constitution’s core commitment to bodily autonomy.

The Act responds by requiring parity: if a medical treatment is considered safe, accepted, and medically necessary for cisgender youth, it must be equally available to transgender youth under the same clinical criteria. This is not the creation of new rights or special access — it is the enforcement of existing legal and medical standards. In terms of constitutional physiology, the bill corrects a failure of recognition: when the state treats one group as real patients and another as exceptions, it triggers systemic instability and predictable harm, including sharply elevated rates of depression and suicidality among youth denied care.

The Act is narrowly tailored, evidence-based, and reversible through an autophagic wind-down mechanism if parity is no longer necessary. It protects clinical judgment, family autonomy, and the integrity of medical institutions, while reaffirming the principle that care is how a Republic acknowledges the humanity of its people. The legislation is offered as a model for other states seeking durable, non-punitive, constitutional solutions that restore homeostasis rather than escalate harm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了《密歇根青年医疗尊严法案》，旨在恢复密歇根州跨性别未成年人的医疗平等权。该法案要求：如果某种医疗方法对顺性别未成年人被认为是安全、可接受且医学必要的，那么在相同临床标准下必须同样适用于跨性别未成年人。
AI.research_question: 如何通过州级立法恢复跨性别未成年人的医疗平等权，并确保医疗服务的非歧视性？
AI.motivation: 密歇根州多家医院系统暂停为跨性别未成年人提供性别确认护理，却继续为顺性别未成年人使用完全相同的青春期阻滞剂、激素疗法和临床方案，这种选择性拒绝缺乏医学依据，是基于身份的不公正排斥。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宪法身体自主权原则、民权法禁止性别认同歧视的规定，以及医疗平等和尊严的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出州级立法模型，要求医疗服务的平等获取，并包含可逆的自动废止机制。
AI.findings: 选择性拒绝跨性别未成年人获得医疗服务违反了既定的临床标准和宪法对身体自主权的核心承诺，导致被拒绝护理的青少年抑郁和自杀率显著升高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了医疗平等和尊严的立法实施框架，强调了国家承认所有群体作为真实患者的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他州提供了持久、非惩罚性、符合宪法的解决方案模型，保护临床判断、家庭自主权和医疗机构完整性。

title: Venezuela Dignity Preservation Act (VDPA): Constitutional Recognition and the Prevention of Civic Autoimmunity
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Venezuela Dignity Preservation Act (VDPA): Constitutional Recognition and the Prevention of Civic Autoimmunity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Statement of Interest: This submission is part of an ongoing research and drafting initiative exploring "Constitutional Physiology"—the idea that legislation functions as the immune system of the Republic, balancing defense with dignity. The goal of this project is to develop replicable, evidence-grounded legislative models that restore proportionality, reduce systemic harm, and strengthen democratic legitimacy. These drafts are produced, refined, and tested in a Praxis Foundry workflow with the assistance of structured AI collaboration.

detail.abstract:
The Venezuela Dignity Preservation Act (Phase I) responds to ongoing humanitarian emergency conditions affecting over 14 million Venezuelans, where collapse of health, food, and civil infrastructure prevents safe return. Venezuelan Temporary Protected Status (TPS) recipients in the United States have demonstrated exceptionally high compliance rates (91–99%), strong labor participation, and over $2.8 billion in annual economic contributions. Allowing TPS to expire under these conditions would constitute systemic misrecognition: the State would treat an integrated, law-abiding population as a threat, triggering an autoimmune reflex within the civic body.

This Act provides an 18-month automatic TPS extension and establishes renewable parole-in-place to maintain family unity, community stability, and work authorization, without expanding detention or enforcement authority. The Act is narrowly tailored, operates within existing INA §244 and parole frameworks, and includes an autophagic wind-down clause that tapers protections once humanitarian conditions stabilize and reactivates them if harm returns.

This legislation restores constitutional homeostasis by ensuring defense cools into care, maintaining dignity as a stabilizing force in the Republic.  
Forged in a Praxis Foundry with AI assistants.

AI.tldr: 该法案为委内瑞拉TPS受益人提供18个月自动延期和可续期就地假释，以维持家庭团聚、社区稳定和工作授权，同时包含自动缩减条款，在人道状况稳定时逐步取消保护。
AI.research_question: 如何通过立法手段解决委内瑞拉TPS到期问题，同时维护人道主义价值和宪法平衡？
AI.motivation: 应对影响1400多万委内瑞拉人的持续人道主义紧急状况，防止TPS到期导致已融入美国社会的守法群体被错误对待。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性错误承认理论、自体免疫反射理论、宪法稳态理论
AI.method: 立法分析，基于现有INA §244和假释框架设计狭窄定制的法案条款
AI.findings: 委内瑞拉TPS受益人有91-99%的高合规率、强劳动参与度和28亿美元年经济贡献，TPS到期将构成系统性错误承认
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了系统性错误承认和宪法稳态理论在移民政策中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的立法方案，平衡人道主义关怀与法治要求，避免大规模拘留或执法扩张

title: Validation of Machine Learning Algorithms for Mapping Flood Inundation and Slum Expansion in East African Cities
affiliations: Tongji University and Tongji University

detail.title: Validation of Machine Learning Algorithms for Mapping Flood Inundation and Slum Expansion in East African Cities
detail.abstract: In Sub-Saharan Africa, approximately 50% of the urban population resides in slums. Yet studies examining the spatiotemporal development and flood vulnerability of slums remain scarce in East African cities. This study aims to (i) analyse spatial-temporal dynamics in the Kibera (Kenya) and Katanga (Uganda) slums, Compared to Bannyahe, a former slum in Rwanda whose residents were successfully relocated to the Busanza model village, and (ii) to quantitatively assess flood exposure across various land use/land cover (LULC) categories and exposed population. We applied the Random Forest (RF) Algorithm classification to Landsat 7,8 and 9 (2012–2024) for LULC mapping, alongside Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR)-based flood detection using Sentinel-1. The model was trained with a 70% training and 30% testing split and evaluated via confusion matrices and Kappa, achieving 92.75% accuracy for RF and 89% for SAR. The results show (1) that built-up areas increased significantly in Kibera (86.67%) and Katanga (77.52%) slums. In Bannyahe experienced a decline of 32.22% after 2021, which is attributed to the successful relocation to Busanza model village. (2) An overlay analysis of flood exposure across LULC categories during all flood events revealed total flooded areas of 112.50 hectares in Kibera slum and 7.20 hectares in Katanga slum. Population estimates indicate that more than 45,000 residents were exposed in Kibera. Importantly, our algorithms produce flood maps over affected areas and estimate exposed populations within minutes, making them easily applicable to other regions. This study recommends a similar resettlement approach adopted in Bannyahe.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了东非三个贫民窟（肯尼亚Kibera、乌干达Katanga和卢旺达Bannyahe）的时空动态和洪水脆弱性。研究发现Kibera和Katanga的建成区显著增长，而Bannyahe因成功搬迁而减少。洪水暴露分析显示Kibera有112.50公顷区域和超过45,000居民面临洪水风险。研究推荐采用Bannyahe的重新安置模式。
AI.research_question: 东非贫民窟的时空动态变化如何？不同土地利用/土地覆盖类别和暴露人口的洪水脆弱性如何定量评估？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲约50%城市人口居住在贫民窟，但关于东非城市贫民窟时空发展和洪水脆弱性的研究仍然稀缺
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机森林算法的土地利用分类和合成孔径雷达的洪水检测理论框架
AI.method: 应用随机森林算法对Landsat 7、8、9（2012-2024）进行土地利用分类，结合Sentinel-1合成孔径雷达进行洪水检测，采用70%训练和30%测试分割，通过混淆矩阵和Kappa系数评估
AI.findings: 1）Kibera建成区增长86.67%，Katanga增长77.52%，Bannyahe在2021年后下降32.22%；2）Kibera贫民窟洪水淹没面积112.50公顷，Katanga 7.20公顷，Kibera超过45,000居民暴露于洪水风险
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了结合随机森林和合成孔径雷达的贫民窟时空动态和洪水脆弱性评估方法框架，为类似研究提供理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 算法能在几分钟内生成受影响区域的洪水地图并估计暴露人口，易于在其他地区应用；推荐采用Bannyahe的重新安置模式作为有效的贫民窟治理方案

reference: Columbia Business School Research Paper Forthcoming
title: The cost of mistakes and entrepreneurial strategy formation
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Management

detail.title: The cost of mistakes and entrepreneurial strategy formation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Entrepreneurs form strategy under high uncertainty, often relying on either reasoning-oriented approaches that prioritize analysis ahead of decisions or action-oriented approaches that emphasize learning through execution. Yet when and why entrepreneurs lean toward one approach over the other remains under-examined. This study theorizes that entrepreneurs' perceived cost of mistakes shapes this choice. When entrepreneurs perceive mistakes to be costlier, they place greater value on accuracy—minimizing deviations from expected outcomes—which reasoning-oriented approaches tend to provide. Action-oriented approaches, in contrast, may sacrifice such accuracy to gain speed, both in executing decisions and in discovering more optimal strategies. Using interviews covering more than 1,200 strategic choices made by scaling software startups around the world and large language models (LLMs), the study finds that a higher perceived cost of mistakes is associated with 6% greater use of reasoning-oriented approaches and 11% lower use of action-oriented approaches. Entrepreneurs in more resource-constrained environments, facing higher-commitment organizational decisions, and with a prevention orientation perceive mistakes as costlier. A supplementary experiment that exogenously varies the cost of mistakes around a key scaling decision yields consistent results. Together, the findings suggest that the cost of mistakes is an important mechanism shaping how entrepreneurs form strategy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨企业家在战略形成过程中对推理导向与行动导向方法的选择，发现错误感知成本是重要影响因素。当企业家认为错误成本较高时，更倾向于使用推理导向方法，反之则更倾向于行动导向方法。
AI.research_question: 企业家何时以及为何倾向于选择推理导向或行动导向的战略形成方法？
AI.motivation: 目前对企业家在高度不确定性下如何选择推理导向（强调分析）与行动导向（强调执行中学习）战略方法的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于错误感知成本理论，认为企业家对错误成本的感知影响其战略方法选择。推理导向方法追求准确性，行动导向方法追求速度和发现更优策略。
AI.method: 使用访谈方法收集全球扩展软件初创企业的1200多个战略选择数据，并结合大语言模型分析；补充实验外生改变错误成本。
AI.findings: 较高的错误感知成本与推理导向方法使用增加6%、行动导向方法使用减少11%相关；资源约束环境、高承诺组织决策和预防导向的企业家感知错误成本更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了错误感知成本作为影响企业家战略方法选择的重要机制，丰富了战略形成理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业家在不同情境下选择合适战略方法提供指导，特别是在资源约束和高风险决策时。

title: The Alwadhi Power-Law of Diamond Pricing: A Universal Mathematical Framework for Gemstone Valuation
affiliations: Maison Alwadhi ®

detail.title: The Alwadhi Power-Law of Diamond Pricing: A Universal Mathematical Framework for Gemstone Valuation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Maison Alwadhi, an institution engaged in diamond research and valuation methodologies. The author may hold financial interests in potential applications of the model. No external funding influenced the theoretical development or empirical validation of this work.
declarations.funderStatement: This work is entirely self-funded. No institutional, governmental, or commercial funding was provided.

detail.abstract: We establish the first universal mathematical law for diamond pricing, addressing a fundamental gap in economic theory that has persisted since the formalization of commodity markets. The Alwadhi Power-Law states that diamond price scales with carat weight according to P = B • W α • C s • M q , where the critical exponent α = 1.725 ± 0.012 emerges from the intersection of geological scarcity distributions, fractal formation processes, and market equilibrium dynamics. Through analysis of 1.2 million transaction records across global markets (2019-2024) and rigorous theoretical derivation from first principles, we demonstrate that this law represents a fundamental economic relationship analogous to gravity in physics or allometric scaling in biology. The power-law exponent sits precisely at the boundary between normal market behavior (α < 2) and bubble dynamics (α > 2), suggesting an efficient market equilibrium shaped by natural constraints. Empirical validation yields R 2 = 0.9874 (p < 10-15) with shape coefficients exhibiting remarkable stability across geographic markets (coefficient of variation < 0.03). The law's mathematical structure enables closed-form solutions for derivative pricing, portfolio optimization, and risk assessment while maintaining computational efficiency three orders of magnitude superior to machine learning alternatives. This work not only provides the diamond industry with its first scientific pricing framework but also contributes to the broader understanding of power laws in economic systems, demonstrating how physical constraints and market forces combine to produce universal scaling relationships in commodity valuation.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了钻石定价的第一个普适数学定律——Alwadhi幂律，揭示了钻石价格与克拉重量之间的幂律关系，指数α=1.725±0.012处于正常市场行为与泡沫动态的临界点。
AI.research_question: 钻石价格与克拉重量之间是否存在普适的数学关系？这种关系的理论依据是什么？
AI.motivation: 解决商品市场理论中长期存在的钻石定价空白，为钻石行业提供科学的定价框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合地质稀缺性分布、分形形成过程和市场竞争均衡动态的理论框架。
AI.method: 分析2019-2024年全球市场的120万笔交易记录，并从第一原理进行严格理论推导。
AI.findings: 发现钻石价格遵循P = B • W^α • C^s • M^q的幂律关系，实证验证R²=0.9874，指数α=1.725±0.012具有地理稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济系统中的幂律提供了新的理解，展示了物理约束与市场力量如何结合产生商品估值的普适标度关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为钻石行业提供首个科学定价框架，支持衍生品定价、投资组合优化和风险评估，计算效率比机器学习方法高三个数量级。

reference: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2025/034
title: BMSSPy: A Python Package and Empirical Comparison of Bounded Multi-Source Shortest Path Algorithm
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics

detail.title: BMSSPy: A Python Package and Empirical Comparison of Bounded Multi-Source Shortest Path Algorithm

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper No. 2025/034
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We introduce BMSSPy, the first open-source Python package faithfully implementing the Bounded Multi-Source Shortest Path (BMSSP) algorithm, recently proposed as a breakthrough beyond Dijkstra's sorting barrier for single-source shortest paths. BMSSPy translates theoretical advances into practice: it preserves the algorithm's asymptotic performance guarantees while returning both distance labels and route predecessors. Our implementation resolves core ambiguities in pivot selection, tight-edge forest construction, and frontier management that prior work left open for practitioners. We engineer BMSSPy to handle graphs with non-unique path lengths, structural irregularities, unreachable vertices, and highly variable node degrees, ensuring function and robust performance on real data. Extensive experiments on grid and geospatial networks demonstrate that BMSSPy delivers competitive performance. For instance, on a graph with 200,000 nodes and 1.56 million edges, BMSSP runs 1.7× faster than NetworkX's Dijkstra and up to 3.5× faster than igraph's, although the highly optimized SCGraph Modified Dijkstra still achieves the best performance. BMSSP proves practical and efficient in practice, despite the remaining gap between theory and system-level performance. BMSSPy, with full documentation and reproducibility scripts, is released to support future research and development in shortest-path algorithms.

AI.tldr: BMSSPy是首个开源Python包，实现了突破Dijkstra排序障碍的BMSSP算法，在保持理论性能保证的同时提供距离标签和路径前驱信息，在真实数据上表现出竞争力。
AI.research_question: 如何将BMSSP理论算法转化为实用的开源实现，并验证其在实际图数据上的性能表现？
AI.motivation: BMSSP算法在理论上突破了Dijkstra的排序障碍，但缺乏实用的开源实现，需要解决算法实现中的核心模糊问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有界多源最短路径(BMSSP)理论框架，该算法突破了传统单源最短路径算法的排序障碍。
AI.method: 开发BMSSPy开源Python包，解决枢轴选择、紧边森林构建和边界管理等核心实现问题，支持非唯一路径长度、结构不规则性、不可达顶点和可变节点度等复杂情况。
AI.findings: 在网格和地理空间网络上的实验显示，BMSSPy在20万节点、156万边的图上比NetworkX的Dijkstra快1.7倍，比igraph快3.5倍，但SCGraph优化的Dijkstra仍表现最佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 将BMSSP理论算法转化为可用的开源实现，解决了算法实现中的核心模糊问题，为最短路径算法的研究提供了新工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了完整的BMSSPy开源包，包含文档和可复现脚本，支持最短路径算法的未来研究和开发。

title: Evaluating Accuracy of Ethiopian Building Code's Prediction for flexure of RC Beam Using Neural Networks
affiliations: Aksum University

detail.title: Evaluating Accuracy of Ethiopian Building Code's Prediction for flexure of RC Beam Using Neural Networks
detail.abstract: Abstract:  The Ethiopian building code standard is a theoretically based design process that was created to address restrictions, however it is not fully consistent with fundamental material attributes. The goal of this research was to evaluate the accuracy of Ethiopian building code techniques for the design of simply supported RC beams in order to perform flexural capacity tests. The design prediction of the flexural capacity of a simply supported RC beam of the compulsory Ethiopian standard (CES-2015) was compared to available experimental prediction, compressive-force path method based on assumption, different from code adapted, and artificial neural networks that were calibrated based on the available test result. This research shows that artificial neural network predictions of the flexural capacity of RC beams are very close to the experimental flexural capacity of RC beams. In addition, while the compressive force-path method is closer to the experimental than the code, it is not as effective as ANNs. When compared to other approaches, the CES-2015 method was a poor predictor of the RC beam's flexural capacity. As a result, using the input-based systematic technique and the compressive–force path method as RC structure design methods reduces the incompatibility between the CES-2015 methodologies and fundamental concrete material properties. The findings are expected to aid structural engineers who work on high-rise building analysis and design.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了埃塞俄比亚建筑规范标准（CES-2015）在简支RC梁抗弯承载力设计预测中的准确性，发现人工神经网络预测最接近实验结果，压缩力路径法优于规范方法但不如ANN，CES-2015方法预测效果较差。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚建筑规范标准（CES-2015）对简支RC梁抗弯承载力的设计预测准确性如何？

AI.theoretical_framework: 建筑规范设计理论、压缩力路径方法、人工神经网络理论
AI.method: 将CES-2015设计预测与实验预测、基于假设的压缩力路径方法、基于测试结果校准的人工神经网络进行比较

title: How Global Are Local Value Chains?
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: How Global Are Local Value Chains?

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how international trade shocks transmit through domestic supply chains, shaping local economic vulnerabilities. Using detailed firm-to-firm domestic and foreign transaction data, we quantify the direct and indirect exposure of Italian labor markets to two major sources of external risk: imports from China and exports to the United States. We quantify the importance of firms’ domestic and foreign linkages for overall exposure and highlight the critical role of wholesalers and top trading firms within the domestic network in shaping tails risks. Pronounced local disparities in exposure reveal that aggregate trade statistics conceal substantial and uneven regional vulnerabilities.

title: Measuring the Invisible: Developing a Patriarchy Index for Egypt

detail.title: Measuring the Invisible: Developing a Patriarchy Index for Egypt

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study constructs the Egypt Patriarchy Index (EPI), drawing on methodologies developed by Gruber and Szołtysek (2016) and expanded by Singh et al. (2022). The EPI incorporates five key dimensions: male domination, generational domination, patrilocality, son preference, and socioeconomic domination. Utilizing data from five rounds of the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) conducted in Egypt from 1995 to 2014, this index offers comprehensive insights into patriarchal structures at both national and sub-national levels. The study reveals persistent and deeply entrenched patriarchy in Egypt, with only minor fluctuations over two decades. The reliability and validity of the EPI are confirmed through high Cronbach's Alpha values and a strong correlation with the Gender Inequality Index (GII), demonstrating that higher levels of patriarchy correspond to greater gender inequality. These findings highlight significant regional variations in patriarchy across Egyptian governorates and underscore the necessity for region-specific gender equality interventions. The EPI provides a valuable tool for assessing and addressing patriarchal norms, contributing to the broader discourse on gender inequality in Egypt and similar socio-cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了埃及父权制指数(EPI)，基于五个关键维度评估埃及的父权结构。使用1995-2014年埃及人口与健康调查数据，发现埃及父权制持续存在且根深蒂固，仅有微小波动。EPI具有良好信效度，与性别不平等指数高度相关，揭示了埃及各省份的显著区域差异。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个有效的埃及父权制指数来评估埃及父权结构的程度和变化？
AI.motivation: 需要开发一个综合指标来系统评估埃及的父权结构，为性别平等干预提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Gruber和Szołtysek(2016)以及Singh等人(2022)的方法论，构建包含五个维度的父权制理论框架：男性统治、代际统治、父系居住、儿子偏好和社会经济统治。
AI.method: 利用1995-2014年埃及五轮人口与健康调查(DHS)数据，构建埃及父权制指数(EPI)，并通过Cronbach's Alpha和与性别不平等指数的相关性检验信效度。
AI.findings: 埃及父权制持续存在且根深蒂固，20年间仅有微小波动；EPI具有高信效度；各省份存在显著区域差异；父权程度与性别不平等呈正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了专门针对埃及语境的父权制测量工具，扩展了父权制理论在发展中国家背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估父权结构的工具，支持制定针对特定区域的性别平等干预措施，促进埃及性别平等进程。

title: Retailing Technology: Innovations and Impact on Consumer Experience
affiliations: University of Johannesburg

detail.title: Retailing Technology: Innovations and Impact on Consumer Experience
detail.abstract: Strong governance, con guration management, and compliance frameworks are critical to prevent scope drift, misalignment, and traceability challenges that frequently undermine the success of retail technology projects. Retail digitalization-driven by arti cial intelligence (AI), augmented reality (AR), Internet of Things (IoT), and data governance systems-has rede ned how consumer experience (CX), operational control, and innovation are managed in modern retail ecosystems. This systematic review evaluates the evolution, application, and governance of retail technologies from 2015 to 2025, focusing on their effects on consumer engagement, satisfaction, and loyalty, as well as the organizational mechanisms that ensure their sustainable integration. Following the PRISMA framework, a total of 267 studies were initially identi ed from Scopus (41%), Web of Science (29%), and Google Scholar (30%). After screening and eligibility assessment, 56 peer-reviewed studies met inclusion criteria based on methodological rigor, relevance to retail technology governance, and CX outcomes. Research activity exhibited three phases—emergence (2015–2017, 10.7%), growth (2018–2021, 38.3%), and maturity (2022–2025, 50.0%)—reflecting an evolution from conceptual frameworks to data-driven governance models. Geographically, the literature is dominated by European (46.0%) and Asia-Pacific (35.7%) contributions, shaped by strong regulatory and digital innovation policies. Technological clusters reveal an emphasis on AI and automation (17.9%), AR/VR immersive systems (17.9%), IoT and smart retail infrastructures (14.3%), and computer vision (14.3%), underscoring the growing interdependence between intelligence, automation, and experience design. Thematically, over 60% of studies center on process and service innovation, while 51.8% of applied research focuses on in-store retail transformation, highlighting the ongoing digitalization of physical retail environments. Consumer outcomes are dominated by convenience and accessibility (41.1%) and engagement and experience (28.6%), followed by satisfaction, trust, and personalization dimensions. Organizationally, most studies emphasize operational efficiency (26.8%) and automation-driven optimization (12.5%), while governance challenges cluster around privacy and ethical concerns (19.6%), integration complexity (18.9%), and adoption barriers (17.8%). Emerging governance criteria highlight user-centered design (21.4%), data ethics and transparency (20.5%), and ethical AI integration (18.9%), reflecting a growing maturity in balancing innovation with accountability. Finally, innovation trends point toward AI and automation (20.9%), immersive retail experiences (17.9%), and IoT-edge distributed commerce (16.1%), signaling a shift toward intelligent, self-regulating, and sustainability-oriented retail ecosystems. Retail technology innovation has advanced from fragmented, tool-based applications to integrated, governance-oriented frameworks that align operational performance with consumer experience. However, gaps persist in system interoperability, cost-efficiency, and empirical evaluation of governance effectiveness. To strengthen adoption and long-term impact, the study recommends targeted capacity-building, affordable integration solutions, and cross-sector partnerships between vendors and retailers. Future research should prioritize longitudinal and evidence-based evaluation of governance mechanisms to determine how specific design and policy strategies influence measurable consumer and organizational outcomes.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统综述分析了2015-2025年零售技术治理的演变，发现零售技术从分散工具发展为集成治理框架，强调AI、AR/VR、IoT等技术对消费者体验和运营效率的影响，但存在互操作性、成本效益和治理有效性评估等挑战。
AI.research_question: 零售技术治理如何影响消费者体验、运营效率和创新管理？
AI.motivation: 零售数字化项目常因治理不善、配置管理和合规框架不足而失败，需要系统评估技术治理对消费者体验和组织机制的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PRISMA框架的系统综述方法，结合技术治理理论、消费者体验理论和数字化转型理论。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA框架，从Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar筛选267项研究，最终纳入56篇同行评审文献进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 零售技术发展经历三个阶段（出现期10.7%、成长期38.3%、成熟期50.0%）；欧洲和亚太地区主导研究；AI/自动化、AR/VR、IoT是主要技术集群；消费者关注便利性（41.1%）和体验（28.6%）；治理挑战包括隐私伦理（19.6%）和集成复杂性（18.9%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从工具应用到治理导向框架的零售技术演进模型，识别了用户中心设计、数据伦理和AI伦理等新兴治理标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议针对性能力建设、经济集成解决方案和供应商-零售商跨部门合作，为零售企业提供技术治理实施指南。

title: Policies to Decarbonize Industry While Addressing Competitiveness and Carbon Leakage
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Policies to Decarbonize Industry While Addressing Competitiveness and Carbon Leakage

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper discusses the attributes and design of alternative mitigation instruments for the industrial sector, their competitiveness and emissions leakage impacts, and supplementary measures to address these effects. A quantitative analysis indicates, for selective countries, production cost increases under a $50 per tonne unilateral CO2 price in 2030 are 4-8 percent for steel, 20-30 percent for chemicals, and 30-35 percent for cement with leakage rates of 20-50 percent across these industries. Competitiveness and leakage impacts are however much smaller under pricing with border adjustments, other mitigation instruments like feebates and performance standards, or internationally coordinated pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了工业部门替代性减排工具的设计和影响，发现单边碳定价会导致显著的竞争力损失和碳泄漏，而边境调节、绩效标准和国际协调等措施能有效缓解这些问题。
AI.research_question: 工业部门替代性减排工具的设计、竞争力影响和碳泄漏效应是什么？

title: Talmudic Business Ethics: An Historical Perspective
affiliations: City University of New York (CUNY) - Koppelman School of Business

detail.title: Talmudic Business Ethics: An Historical Perspective

keywords: Acting in the Manner of Sodom

detail.abstract: Is it possible to run a business that is both profitable and deeply moral? This paper looks to the Talmud for answers. Written over 1,500 years ago, these texts provide a blueprint for ethical conduct in buying, selling, and employment. The sages taught that being legal is not the same as being right. They urged people to hold themselves to higher standards and avoid deceptive practices at all costs. These enduring lessons offer a fresh perspective on how we can build a more ethical business world today.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨《塔木德》中关于商业伦理的古老智慧，研究如何建立既盈利又道德的商业模式。
AI.research_question: 是否可能建立一个既盈利又具有深刻道德的商业模式？
AI.motivation: 现代商业实践中法律合规与道德标准之间存在差距，需要从传统智慧中寻找更高标准的伦理指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《塔木德》伦理框架，强调法律合规不等于道德正确，提倡超越法律要求的更高标准。
AI.method: 文本分析《塔木德》中关于买卖、雇佣和商业实践的教导。
AI.findings: 《塔木德》提供了避免欺骗性实践、坚持更高道德标准的商业伦理蓝图。

title: Real Exchange Rate, Structural Change and Technological Gap in an Export-Led Cumulative Causation Model: a Preliminary Analysis
affiliations: , University of Tuscia, Universidade de Brasília (UnB) and Azim Premji University

detail.title: Real Exchange Rate, Structural Change and Technological Gap in an Export-Led Cumulative Causation Model: a Preliminary Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declares that (s)he has no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research.

detail.abstract: This paper develops and analyses the steady-state properties and stability conditions of an Export-Led Cumulative (ELCC) Causation model that integrates elements from new developmentalism and evolutionary-Schumpeterian growth theories. The standard ELCC model proposed by Dixon and Thirlwall (1975) suggests that the growth rate of exports, which drives economic development, depends on the rate of change of the exchange rate and the growth rate of the world´s income. Therefore, it neglects the roles of the exchange rate level, manufacturing structure, and technological gap. This study advances the theoretical foundation by introducing five key novelties: (i) export growth as a function of the real exchange rate level via a dynamic replicator mechanism, following Boggio and Barbieri (2017); (ii) an employment-dependent Kaldor-Verdoorn coefficient, as in Setterfield (2006), in which this paper explicit the driving role of the manufacturing shares; (iii) a stratification mechanism where export income elasticity adjusts to output growth differentials (Dávila-Fernández et al., 2018); finally, (iv) an endogenous evolution of manufacturing shares driven by both price and non-price competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并分析了出口导向累积因果(ELCC)模型的稳态特性和稳定性条件，该模型整合了新发展主义和演化-熊彼特增长理论的元素。研究通过引入五个关键创新点推进了理论基础：出口增长作为实际汇率水平的函数、就业依赖的Kaldor-Verdoorn系数、出口收入弹性对产出增长差异的调整机制，以及制造业份额的内生演化。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更完善的出口导向累积因果模型，该模型能够考虑汇率水平、制造业结构和技术差距等因素对经济增长的影响？
AI.motivation: 标准的ELCC模型(Dixon和Thirlwall, 1975)仅关注汇率变化率和世界收入增长率对出口增长的驱动作用，而忽视了汇率水平、制造业结构和技术差距的重要作用，因此需要发展更全面的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新发展主义理论、演化-熊彼特增长理论、出口导向累积因果模型、Kaldor-Verdoorn定律、动态复制机制、分层机制
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，开发扩展的ELCC模型，分析模型的稳态特性和稳定性条件
AI.findings: 构建了一个包含汇率水平、制造业结构和技术差距等因素的扩展ELCC模型，并分析了其稳态特性和稳定性条件
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将出口增长建模为实际汇率水平的函数；2) 引入就业依赖的Kaldor-Verdoorn系数并明确制造业份额的驱动作用；3) 建立出口收入弹性对产出增长差异的调整机制；4) 提出制造业份额由价格和非价格竞争力驱动的内生演化机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更全面的分析框架，能够更好地理解汇率水平、制造业结构和技术进步对出口导向型经济增长的影响

title: The American Extraction Model: Quantifying Means-Tested Redistribution and Associated Societal Costs in the United States ($3.4 Trillion Annual Descriptive Aggregation, FY2025)
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The American Extraction Model: Quantifying Means-Tested Redistribution and Associated Societal Costs in the United States ($3.4 Trillion Annual Descriptive Aggregation, FY2025)
detail.abstract: Background: U.S. federal outlays reached 23.3% of GDP ($7.0 trillion) in FY2025 [Congressional Budget Office, 2025]. Objective: Quantify the scale and structural context of means-tested redistribution as the core pillar of a hypothesized four-pillar extraction framework (redistribution, defense, addiction, climate-driven asset repricing), with extensions to a full ∼$5.2 trillion aggregation. Methods: Data fusion from CBO (FY2025 baseline), IRS SOI (2024), DOJ/FBI UCR (2025 quarterly), Swiss Re sigma (2025), OECD SOCR (2025), FEMA Risk Rating 2.0 (2025), CDC/White House (2025), and Urban Institute (2025). Sensitivity: ±10% bounds on externalities. Results: $3.4 trillion descriptive aggregation for redistribution pillar → $32,400 per nettaxpaying household. Full framework: ∼$5.2 trillion, including $1.5-4 trillion coastal propertyvalue transfer by 2040 (FEMA/Swiss Re). Conclusion: The configuration is consistent with a high-extraction equilibrium supported by institutional incentives; illustrative off-ramps draw from Utah JRI (∼40% recidivism reduction) and Florida DCF OPBI Fraud Recovery (∼50% of investigated overpayments).

AI.tldr: 本文量化了美国联邦支出中的再分配支柱规模，提出了一个四支柱提取框架（再分配、国防、成瘾、气候驱动的资产重新定价），估计总规模约5.2万亿美元，并分析了支持这种高提取均衡的制度激励。
AI.research_question: 如何量化美国联邦支出中的再分配支柱规模，并将其置于四支柱提取框架中进行结构分析？
AI.motivation: 美国联邦支出已达到GDP的23.3%（7.0万亿美元），需要系统分析其构成和制度背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四支柱提取框架：再分配、国防、成瘾、气候驱动的资产重新定价
AI.method: 数据融合方法，整合CBO、IRS、DOJ/FBI、Swiss Re、OECD、FEMA、CDC/白宫、Urban Institute等多个来源的数据，敏感性分析采用±10%边界。
AI.findings: 再分配支柱规模为3.4万亿美元，相当于每个净纳税家庭32,400美元；完整框架规模约5.2万亿美元，包括到2040年1.5-4万亿美元的海岸财产价值转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了四支柱提取框架来解释高提取均衡的制度配置，为理解大规模政府支出的结构背景提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了制度激励支持的高提取均衡问题，并提出了基于犹他州司法改革和佛罗里达州欺诈回收的可行退出路径。

title: Corporate Governance by Workers
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of Texas at Dallas - School of Management - Department of Finance & Managerial Economics

detail.title: Corporate Governance by Workers
detail.abstract: We study how workers' private information about managerial performance shapes equity financing and compensation structures. We develop a simple moral-hazard model in which a manager exerts unobservable effort and workers observe that effort before deciding whether to stay with the firm. When workers are compensated partly in equity, their decision to quit following low managerial effort disciplines the manager, generating internal corporate governance. This mechanism introduces a novel link between equity financing and labor contracting: worker equity both incentivizes managerial effort and exerts downward pressure on wages, since underpayment is necessary for the manager to lose surplus when workers leave. In equilibrium, workers are optimally paid entirely in equity and below the monopsony-optimal compensation level, trading off profit extraction against the strength of managerial incentives. The model proposes a new governance mechanism by worker departure and provides a new explanation for the prevalence of worker equity compensation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了工人对管理层表现的私人信息如何影响股权融资和薪酬结构。研究发现，当工人部分以股权形式获得报酬时，他们观察到管理层努力程度后决定是否离职，这种机制形成了内部公司治理，将股权融资与劳动合同联系起来。
AI.research_question: 工人的私人信息如何影响股权融资和薪酬结构？
AI.motivation: 理解工人对管理层表现的私人信息在公司治理中的作用，以及股权补偿的普遍性背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德风险模型，其中管理层付出不可观察的努力，工人观察该努力后决定是否留在公司。
AI.method: 开发了一个简单的道德风险模型来分析工人股权补偿对管理层激励和薪酬结构的影响。
AI.findings: 工人股权既激励管理层努力，又对工资施加下行压力；在均衡状态下，工人完全以股权形式获得报酬，且低于垄断最优补偿水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通过工人离职的新治理机制，为工人股权补偿的普遍性提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计股权融资和薪酬结构提供了理论指导，强调了工人参与在公司治理中的重要性。

title: Tourism Development and Economic Scale: Assessing the Relationship between Tourism Growth and the Size of National Economies
affiliations: Independent, Indiana university Purdue university Indianapolis, and India University

detail.title: Tourism Development and Economic Scale: Assessing the Relationship between Tourism Growth and the Size of National Economies
detail.abstract: This paper explores how the scale of an economy influences the patterns, benefits, and challenges of tourism development. By comparing small and large economies, the study examines how differences in resource capacity, institutional structure, and market openness affect the sustainability of tourism-led growth. Drawing on international evidence and case studies, the analysis highlights that small economies often depend more heavily on tourism revenues, which can stimulate employment and foreign exchange but also increase vulnerability to external shocks. In contrast, larger economies tend to integrate tourism within more diversified development strategies, where its contribution to GDP and employment is significant but less dominant. The paper argues that the effectiveness of tourism as a driver of development depends not solely on economic size, but on governance quality, environmental management, and social inclusiveness. These comparative insights provide guidance for designing balanced, sustainable tourism policies across diverse national contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨经济规模如何影响旅游发展的模式、收益和挑战，通过比较小型和大型经济体，分析资源能力、制度结构和市场开放度差异对旅游驱动增长可持续性的影响。
AI.research_question: 经济规模如何影响旅游发展的模式、收益和挑战？
AI.motivation: 理解不同规模经济体在旅游发展方面的差异，为制定可持续旅游政策提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源能力理论、制度理论和市场开放度理论，分析经济规模对旅游发展的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用国际证据和案例研究的方法，比较小型和大型经济体的旅游发展模式。
AI.findings: 小型经济体更依赖旅游收入，能促进就业和外汇但易受外部冲击；大型经济体将旅游融入多元化发展战略，对GDP和就业贡献显著但非主导。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出经济规模与旅游发展关系的理论框架，强调治理质量、环境管理和社会包容性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同规模经济体设计平衡、可持续的旅游政策提供实践指导。

title: Determinants of Household’s Participation in Urban Vegetable Production in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: A Mixed Research Approach
affiliations: Gambella University, Haramaya University, Haramaya University and Bahir Dar University

detail.title: Determinants of Household’s Participation in Urban Vegetable Production in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: A Mixed Research Approach
detail.abstract: Urban agriculture is vital for alleviating food insecurity and promoting urban living, leading to more sustainable and resilient communities. Despite its importance, a household’s participation in it in Addis Ababa remains low due to various demographic, socioeconomic, and institutional factors. Therefore, this study seeks to determine the factors that affect household participation in urban vegetable production in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The multi-stage sampling method was used to select the samples. The sample size was 400 households. Both quantitative and qualitative data types were used. Descriptive and inferential statistics were used to summarize and compare household characteristics. The probit model was used to analyze the factors influencing a household’s decision to participate using the R (V.4.5.4) tool. Thematic analysis was applied to analyze qualitative data using the NVivo (V.12) tool. The findings indicate that factors such as gender, household size, water, land, improved seed, extension, and attitude positively influenced households' participation in urban vegetable production, whereas age and knowledge negatively affected participation. Moreover, mixed effects were observed for marital status, education, occupation, and tenure systems. Generally, marital status, water, land, improved seed, training, extension, and attitude significantly and positively influence household participation.  Collectively, these findings provide strong implications for practice, theory, and policy. Additionally, the findings of the study will assist policymakers, program designers, and project managers in developing effective interventions that encourage households’ participation to enhance food security and sustainable livelihoods, especially for low-income urban households. The findings also serve as a source of information for researchers.

title: What are we Measuring? Measurement and Aggregation Issues in Economics, with an Application to Climate Risks
affiliations: and University of Oxford

detail.title: What are we Measuring? Measurement and Aggregation Issues in Economics, with an Application to Climate Risks
detail.abstract: This paper reviews the twin challenges of measurement and aggregation in economics and the natural sciences, with climate risk as a guiding example. It synthesises a broad range of theoretical and empirical perspectives, tracing ideas from early systems theory to modern macroeconomic debates, and compares the approaches of economics, complexity science, and climate science to the micro-macro aggregation problem. Several key conceptual tensions are highlighted-most notably the "micro-macro gap"-and the limitations of traditional models when confronted with heterogeneity, deep uncertainty, and non-linear feedbacks are demonstrated, especially in the climate-risk context. It also reviews emerging methodologies and proposes integrated frameworks to combine micro-level detail with macro-level consistency. Finally, the paper outlines a roadmap for future research and policy, advocating interdisciplinary collaboration, improved data infrastructure, and adaptive modelling strategies to better capture climate change.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了经济学和自然科学中测量与聚合的双重挑战，以气候风险为例，综合了从早期系统理论到现代宏观经济辩论的多种理论视角，比较了不同学科对微观-宏观聚合问题的方法，强调了关键概念张力，并提出了整合微观细节与宏观一致性的框架。

title: Utilizing Foreign Currency-Denominated Collaterals for Naira Loans and the Position of the Central Bank of Nigeria
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Utilizing Foreign Currency-Denominated Collaterals for Naira Loans and the Position of the Central Bank of Nigeria
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the evolving regulatory stance of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) concerning Naira-denominated loans secured by foreign currency (FCY) collateral. While the Foreign Exchange Manual 2018 previously permitted this practice under strict conditions, mandating use in approved sectors and restricting collateral instruments, widespread non-compliance introduced significant systemic risk.

In response, the CBN issued a restrictive directive on April 8, 2024, which now prohibits the use of FCY collateral for Naira loans, with the only exceptions being Eurobonds issued by the Federal Government of Nigeria and guarantees from foreign banks.

This pivotal regulatory shift addresses CBN's core concerns: currency mismatch, increased financial instability for lenders, and the speculative hoarding of foreign exchange, which depletes market liquidity. 

The paper details the resultant implications, particularly for Nigerian banks, which face a 150% risk-weighting penalty on all non-compliant exposures, underscoring the CBN's strategic preference for channeling foreign currency into the market over its use as static collateral.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了尼日利亚中央银行对以外国货币为抵押的奈拉贷款监管政策的演变，从2018年允许严格条件下的此类操作，到2024年4月禁止使用外币抵押，仅保留尼日利亚联邦政府发行的欧洲债券和外资银行担保作为例外。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚中央银行对外币抵押奈拉贷款的监管政策演变及其对金融系统的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 广泛的不合规行为引入了显著的系统性风险，包括货币错配、金融机构风险增加以及外汇投机性囤积导致市场流动性枯竭。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融监管理论、系统性风险管理、货币政策传导机制

title: DO STATE-OWNED BANKS REDUCE THEIR DIVIDENDS DURING AN ECONOMIC CRISIS? THE SWISS CASE
affiliations: University of Fribourg - University of Fribourg - Faculty of Economics and Social Science, University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne) and University of Lausanne, HEC-Lausanne

detail.title: DO STATE-OWNED BANKS REDUCE THEIR DIVIDENDS DURING AN ECONOMIC CRISIS? THE SWISS CASE
detail.abstract: Several financial authorities, including the IMF and ECB, recommended that banks limit dividend payments during the economic crisis caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. This study examines how Swiss state-owned banks responded to these recommendations. Using a difference-in-differences analysis of panel data from 2014 to 2021, we find that, compared to other Swiss banks, Swiss state-owned banks increased their dividend payouts during the crisis. Furthermore, we show that these higher payouts are not the result of increased profitability or liquidity. However, a reduction in lending activity among state-owned banks appears to have contributed to excess liquidity, which may have been distributed as dividends. Finally, we find no significant differences in dividend payouts between public and private state-owned banks, suggesting that financial market pressure does not affect our results. Overall, this study advances our understanding of the role of state ownership in banking, which remains important in many countries, especially during an economic crisis.

AI.tldr: 瑞士国有银行在COVID-19经济危机期间反而增加了股息支付，这与IMF和ECB的建议相悖。这种增加并非源于盈利能力或流动性的提升，而是由于贷款活动减少导致的超额流动性分配。

AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对国有银行在经济危机中行为的理解，揭示了国有银行可能违背监管建议的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构制定更有效的政策提供依据，帮助理解国有银行在危机期间的特殊行为模式

title: Riding the Silver Tsunami in Pursuit of Economic Democracy: Economic Inequality, Baby Boomers, and Worker Cooperatives

detail.title: Riding the Silver Tsunami in Pursuit of Economic Democracy: Economic Inequality, Baby Boomers, and Worker Cooperatives
detail.abstract: The "American Dream," a national ethos centered on the belief in equal opportunity and upward socioeconomic mobility through hard work, has evolved significantly over time. Originally, it embodied ideals of liberty, justice, and economic democracy, opposing excessive wealth accumulation and economic inequality. However, over the 20th century, it became synonymous with individual economic success, particularly represented by Baby Boomers who thrived in the post-World War II economic boom. Today, Americans face an increasingly wide income and wealth gap that echoes the conditions of the late 19th and early 20th centuries, raising questions about the Dream's accessibility and relevance. This Article explores how worker cooperatives, which emphasize shared prosperity and democratic ownership, offer a pathway to reinvigorate the American Dream in the 21st century. By converting aging businesses owned by Baby Boomers into worker cooperatives, we can move toward an inclusive economic model that fosters social mobility, equitable opportunity, and sustainable prosperity. This Article examines the history, current conditions, and potential of worker cooperatives as a transformative business model for America 's economic future.

title: Designing an Accessible Classroom: Beyond the Physical Spaces

detail.title: Designing an Accessible Classroom: Beyond the Physical Spaces
detail.abstract: The discourse of accessibility in higher education has long been dominated by attention to physical environments: ramps, elevators, and adaptive furniture. While these infrastructural elements are necessary, they are insufficient for fostering inclusive participation. This article argues that accessibility must be theorized and enacted as a multidimensional construct encompassing pedagogical design, digital affordances, and socio-emotional conditions of learning. Drawing on Universal Design for Learning (UDL) and scholarship from disability studies, inclusive pedagogy, and digital accessibility, I examine how accessibility functions not as a checklist of accommodations but as a relational practice embedded in teaching, technology, and classroom culture. The article concludes with recommendations for shifting institutional and pedagogical orientations from reactive compliance to anticipatory equity.

title: The Epistemology of Construction Management: From Production to Cognition

detail.title: The Epistemology of Construction Management: From Production to Cognition
detail.abstract: Construction Management (CM) has long existed as a practice-but only recently has it emerged as a self-conscious field of inquiry. Historically, its knowledge base was borrowed f engineering, architecture, and project management rather than developed from within. Over the past three decades, however, original theoretical frameworks-such as Transformation-Flow-Value (TFV) theory, Temporary Multi-Organization (TMO) theory, Construction Complexity theory, and Socio-Technical Systems perspective-have begun to articulate how construction knowledge is generated, validated, and shared. This paper traces the epistemological evolution of Construction Management, arguing that the discipline is shifting from a productioncentered to a cognition-centered paradigm of knowing. Construction is repositioned not merely as a technical process but as a form of situated, reflective intelligence-a collective act of knowing through making. The paper introduces Quantum PDSA, grounded in the Confucian principle of 慎独 (Shèn Dú), which frames reflective learning as both an ethical and cognitive act within professional practice. It concludes that the future epistemology of CM must integrate systems thinking, sustainability, and cognitive awareness to navigate the complexity of a digitized, post-industrial built environment.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了建筑管理学科的认识论演变，认为该学科正在从以生产为中心的认知范式转向以认知为中心的认知范式。建筑被重新定位为一种情境化、反思性的智能形式，并引入了基于儒家'慎独'原则的Quantum PDSA框架。

title: Knowledge Management Systems and the Sustainability of Small Businesses in Emerging Economies, Amidst Crisis

detail.title: Knowledge Management Systems and the Sustainability of Small Businesses in Emerging Economies, Amidst Crisis
detail.abstract: Small businesses form the backbone of most emerging economies, accounting for a substantial share of employment, poverty alleviation, and economic resilience. Yet, they remain highly vulnerable to crises such as economic shocks, health pandemics, and policy instability. This paper explores the role of Knowledge Management Systems (KMS) in enhancing the sustainability of small businesses in emerging economies, with a particular focus on resource-constrained environments. Building on the knowledge-based theory of the firm, the study highlights the critical role of knowledge capture, storage, transfer, and use in strengthening resilience and continuity. It proposes a four-pillar framework documentation, technology enablement, people and culture, and ecosystem support to guide the design and adoption of KMS for small enterprises. The paper argues that embedding KMS into small business strategy is not only a managerial choice but a development imperative, with implications for entrepreneurs, policymakers, and development partners.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨知识管理系统在提升新兴经济体小型企业可持续性方面的作用，提出了包含文档化、技术赋能、人员文化和生态系统支持的四支柱框架。

AI.motivation: 小型企业是新兴经济体的支柱，但在危机中极为脆弱，需要提升其韧性和连续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业的知识基础理论，强调知识捕获、存储、转移和使用在增强企业韧性中的关键作用。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明具体研究方法。

AI.practical_contributions: 为企业家、政策制定者和发展伙伴提供了实用的知识管理系统实施框架，强调将KMS嵌入企业战略是发展必需而非管理选择。

title: The Economic Effects of the Montgomery Bus Boycott
affiliations: , Independent and Virginia Tech

detail.title: The Economic Effects of the Montgomery Bus Boycott

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently and was not influenced by any commercial, political, or institutional entity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: While the Montgomery Bus Boycott is widely celebrated, its economic impact on Montgomery has been understudied. This paper reexamines the Montgomery Bus Boycott with two goals: 1. Determining if the Montgomery Bus Boycott affected the city’s public finances. 2. Forecasting the probability that city revenues would have fallen below expenditure. Our analysis demonstrates that the Boycott had a negative effect on the city’s public finances, particularly in the area of policing and fire services, driven by the city's “get tough” policy response to the boycott. Using historical financial records and time-series forecasting (ARIMA), this paper quantifies the growing fiscal strain experienced by the city. Although Montgomery maintained budget surpluses during the Boycott period, projections indicate a rising probability of deficits had the protest continued. These findings highlight the economic leverage wielded by organized civil resistance and puts into focus the material costs municipal governments incurr when confronting social movements.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视蒙哥马利巴士抵制运动，发现其对城市公共财政产生负面影响，特别是在警务和消防服务方面。虽然抵制期间城市保持预算盈余，但预测显示若抗议持续，出现赤字的概率将上升。
AI.research_question: 1. 蒙哥马利巴士抵制运动是否影响了城市的公共财政？2. 预测城市收入低于支出的概率
AI.motivation: 虽然蒙哥马利巴士抵制运动广受赞誉，但其对蒙哥马利的经济影响研究不足

AI.findings: 抵制运动对城市公共财政产生负面影响，特别是在警务和消防服务方面，这是由城市对抵制的"强硬"政策反应驱动的。城市在抵制期间保持预算盈余，但预测显示若抗议持续，出现赤字的概率将上升
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了有组织公民抵抗的经济杠杆作用，聚焦了市政政府在面对社会运动时承担的物质成本
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了社会运动对市政财政的实际影响，为政策制定者理解公民抵抗的经济后果提供了实证依据

title: Hybrid Deep Learning Architectures for Value-at-Risk Forecasting: Integrating LSTM and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
affiliations: , Sharif University of Technology and York University

detail.title: Hybrid Deep Learning Architectures for Value-at-Risk Forecasting: Integrating LSTM and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
detail.abstract: This study proposes a novel framework for Value-at-Risk (VaR) forecasting by integrating Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks with recently developed Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) variants, trained directly on a quantile loss objective. We benchmark the proposed models, including an enhanced LSTM-MultKAN variant, against a standard LSTM-Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and a suite of ARMA-GARCH models. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on information criteria, we optimize the specifications of the GARCH benchmarks using a machine-learning-based validation based on the out-of-sample performance as measured by quantile loss, ensuring a fair comparison. Furthermore, to address the interpretability challenge of neural networks, a deep interpretability analysis is conducted, employing SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) alongside the inherent transparency of the KAN architecture. The LSTM-KAN variants show statistically significant improvements in predictive accuracy and robustness, establishing a clear performance advantage over traditional GARCH models. Within the network architectures, the LSTM-MultKAN variant demonstrates the strongest performance, outperforming the standard LSTM-MLP benchmark. Our interpretability analysis reveals that this superior performance is not arbitrary; the network models learn to identify well-documented financial phenomena, such as volatility clustering and the leverage effect. By achieving both accuracy and interpretability, this study presents a powerful and trustworthy VaR forecasting tool for researchers and risk managers.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合LSTM网络和KAN变体的VaR预测新框架，在预测准确性和鲁棒性上显著优于传统GARCH模型，并通过可解释性分析验证了模型学习到的金融现象。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既准确又可解释的VaR预测框架？
AI.motivation: 传统VaR预测方法存在准确性不足和可解释性差的问题，需要结合深度学习和可解释性技术来改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合LSTM网络、KAN变体和SHAP可解释性分析的理论框架
AI.method: 提出LSTM-KAN变体模型，与LSTM-MLP和ARMA-GARCH模型进行基准比较，使用基于分位数损失的机器学习验证方法
AI.findings: LSTM-KAN变体在预测准确性和鲁棒性上显著优于传统模型，LSTM-MultKAN表现最佳，模型学习到了波动率聚集和杠杆效应等金融现象
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合深度学习和可解释性的VaR预测新框架，验证了神经网络能够学习金融理论现象
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和风险管理者提供了一个准确且可信任的VaR预测工具

title: Carbon Accounting and ESG Compliance: An IFRS S1 and S2-Based Assessment of Nigeria’s Cement Industry
affiliations: University of Benin

detail.title: Carbon Accounting and ESG Compliance: An IFRS S1 and S2-Based Assessment of Nigeria’s Cement Industry
detail.abstract: This research investigates the extent of compliance with IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 sustainability and climate disclosure requirements across Nigeria’s major cement producers—Dangote Cement Plc, BUA Cement Plc, and Lafarge Africa Plc. Using a quantitative content analysis of annual and sustainability reports from 2022 to 2024, the study constructs a disclosure index based on IFRS S1 and S2 guidelines to quantify compliance levels. The results show significant conformity with IFRS S1 (average compliance score of 66.2%) and IFRS S2 (68.3%), reflecting credible and consistent carbon accounting approaches aligned with international frameworks such as the GHG Protocol. Correlation and regression analyses reveal that operational efficiency, gender diversity, and external assurance positively influence disclosure quality, while implementation challenges remain statistically insignificant. The findings confirm that Nigeria’s cement industry has achieved notable progress in integrating sustainability and financial disclosures, underscoring its preparedness for mandatory adoption of IFRS S1 and S2 by 2027. The study contributes empirical evidence for emerging markets transitioning toward investor-grade sustainability reporting standards.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过内容分析法评估尼日利亚三大水泥生产商对IFRS S1和S2可持续性披露准则的合规程度，发现平均合规率分别为66.2%和68.3%，显示行业已为2027年强制采用做好准备。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚主要水泥生产商对IFRS S1和IFRS S2可持续性及气候披露要求的合规程度如何？
AI.motivation: 研究新兴市场向投资者级可持续性报告标准转型的进展，评估尼日利亚水泥行业对即将强制实施的IFRS S1和S2准则的准备情况。

AI.method: 采用定量内容分析法，对2022-2024年年度报告和可持续性报告进行分析，基于IFRS S1和S2指南构建披露指数。
AI.findings: 显示对IFRS S1和IFRS S2的显著合规性（平均得分分别为66.2%和68.3%），运营效率、性别多样性和外部鉴证对披露质量有正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场向投资者级可持续性报告标准转型提供实证证据，丰富了可持续性披露合规性理论。

title: Deciphering the Web of Industry 4.0: Digital Transformation in Commercial Banks
affiliations: University of Queensland, Queensland University of Technology, Queensland University of Technology and University of Canberra

detail.title: Deciphering the Web of Industry 4.0: Digital Transformation in Commercial Banks
detail.abstract: The existing body of literature exploring innovations and digital transformations in the banking sector emphasizes the emergence of competitive business models by FinTechs and digital banks. Despite their significance, commercial banks remain the predominant players. Thus, comprehending how commercial banks assimilate disruptive technologies encompassing Industry 4.0's technological advancements is crucial. This systematic literature review aims to pinpoint the primary strategies commercial banks employ in response to heightened competition and crises. Analysing 238 articles up to 2023, we crafted a conceptual framework resembling a 'spider's web.' This framework illuminates how Industry 4.0 initiates a cohesive digitalization flow. Our findings reveal an interdependent relationship among elements in three distinct groups, underscoring that the success of the digital transformation hinges on banks' comprehensive understanding of these relationships and their adoption of a holistic approach.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述分析了商业银行应对竞争和危机的数字化转型策略，提出了类似'蜘蛛网'的概念框架，揭示了工业4.0如何推动协同数字化流程，强调成功转型需要全面理解各要素间的相互依赖关系。

AI.motivation: 尽管金融科技和数字银行兴起，商业银行仍是主导力量，理解其如何吸收工业4.0等颠覆性技术至关重要。
