title: Is Artificial Intelligence (AI) Changing the Way We Do Economics?
affiliations: Universiti Kuala Lumpur Business School

detail.title: Is Artificial Intelligence (AI) Changing the Way We Do Economics?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NONE
declarations.ethicsApproval: NONE
declarations.funderStatement: NONE

detail.abstract: This paper presents a review of how artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the way we study and practice economics. It explores how new generations of academics, researchers, and students in economics will face new challenges and need to adapt to emerging technologies such as AI. At the same time, it highlights a potential decline in human intellectual performance and an increasing dependency on AI. This study evaluates how AI may influence the creation of new and innovative knowledge in economics while simultaneously contributing to a reduction in human-generated research output. Furthermore, it emphasizes the weakening capacity of humans to independently solve complex and dynamic economic problems. The growing reliance on AI in daily life is expected to become so pervasive that it could eventually influence even the smallest individual and collective decisions. Hence, this paper presents a theoretical analysis supporting the argument that AI may become a destroyer of intellectual creativity and critical thinking in solving complex economic problems a development that could prove irreversible. Additionally, the same research proposes a simple methodology for using artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots in the construction of economic models. It outlines, step by step, how to systematically build an economic model with the support of an AI chatbot such as ChatGPT. This new methodology, called Artificial Intelligence Economic Models Prototyping (AIEM-Prototyping), offers a transformative approach to teaching, learning, and researching economics from a methodological perspective. The process begins with the manual creation of a basic prototype, which is then enhanced through the integration of AI chatbots to evaluate and analyse economic phenomena. AIEM-Prototyping shifts economics from being primarily a theoretical discipline toward a more practical and applied science capable of explaining and simulating dynamic socioeconomic systems through realistic representations. Today, it is possible to create, evaluate, and simulate economic problems using real images or videos generated with ChatGPT. This enables faster comprehension and facilitates the identification of efficient and feasible solutions. Ultimately, AIEM-Prototyping can be applied across all areas of economics, including microeconomics, macroeconomics, applied economics, economic thought, finance, banking, management, business economics, and other related fields.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI如何改变经济学研究与实践，分析AI对学术创新和人类智力的双重影响，并提出AIEM-Prototyping方法论用于构建经济模型。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响经济学研究与实践？AI是否会削弱人类的智力创造力和批判性思维能力？
AI.motivation: 新一代经济学学者面临AI技术带来的挑战，需要适应新兴技术，同时关注人类智力表现下降和对AI依赖增加的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI对知识创造和人类智力影响的理论分析框架
AI.method: 理论分析结合提出的AIEM-Prototyping方法论，使用AI聊天机器人分步骤构建经济模型
AI.findings: AI可能成为智力创造力和批判性思维的破坏者，同时AIEM-Prototyping方法能够将经济学从理论学科转变为更实用的应用科学
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI对经济学知识创造和人类智力影响的理论分析，发展了AIEM-Prototyping方法论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了使用AI聊天机器人构建经济模型的具体步骤和方法，可应用于经济学各领域教学和研究

title: Tourism as a Driver of Economic Transformation: Pathways Toward Sustainable and Inclusive Growth in the Maldives
affiliations: and University of Puerto Rico

detail.title: Tourism as a Driver of Economic Transformation: Pathways Toward Sustainable and Inclusive Growth in the Maldives
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of tourism as a catalyst for economic transformation in the Maldives, a small island developing state where tourism constitutes the backbone of national income, employment, and foreign exchange. Over the past four decades, the sector has evolved from a luxury niche market into a diversified and resilient component of the Maldivian economy. Drawing on policy analysis, institutional reports, and comparative evidence, the study explores how tourism has driven infrastructure expansion, human capital development, and regional integration. It also highlights the growing emphasis on sustainability and inclusiveness as core pillars of national development strategies. The findings suggest that while tourism has successfully propelled economic growth, it also poses environmental and social challenges-ranging from ecosystem degradation to spatial inequality. The paper argues that achieving long-term resilience requires embedding green innovation, local empowerment, and climate adaptation into the tourism model. The Maldivian case provides valuable insights into how small economies can leverage tourism for sustainable and inclusive transformation in a globalized world.

AI.tldr: 本文研究马尔代夫旅游业如何推动经济转型，发现旅游业促进了经济增长但带来环境和社会挑战，建议通过绿色创新、本地赋权和气候适应实现长期韧性。
AI.research_question: 旅游业如何作为马尔代夫经济转型的催化剂？
AI.motivation: 马尔代夫作为小岛屿发展中国家，旅游业是其国民收入、就业和外汇的支柱产业，研究其转型经验对其他小经济体具有借鉴意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济发展理论、旅游经济学、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 政策分析、机构报告分析、比较证据研究
AI.findings: 旅游业推动了基础设施扩张、人力资本发展和区域一体化，但同时也导致生态系统退化和空间不平等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为小岛屿发展中国家如何利用旅游业实现可持续包容性转型提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为马尔代夫及其他类似经济体提供了将绿色创新、本地赋权和气候适应融入旅游模式的实践建议。

title: Cultural Drivers of Economic Outcomes: Cross-Societal Evidence and Comparative Insights

detail.title: Cultural Drivers of Economic Outcomes: Cross-Societal Evidence and Comparative Insights
detail.abstract: Culture profoundly influences how societies organize work, value cooperation, and pursue economic progress. This paper explores how shared beliefs, values, and social norms shape economic outcomes across diverse societies. Drawing on comparative international evidence, it examines the connections between cultural orientations-such as trust, individualism, and long-term thinking-and national patterns of productivity, innovation, and governance. The discussion highlights that economic performance cannot be explained by institutions and resources alone; cultural attitudes toward cooperation, responsibility, and change play a crucial role in sustaining development. Through a crosssocietal perspective, the study illustrates how cultural adaptability fosters innovation and resilience, while rigid or hierarchical traditions may limit growth. Ultimately, the paper argues that successful development strategies must recognize culture not as a background condition but as an active, evolving force that shapes economic behavior and collective prosperity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨文化如何影响经济发展，指出文化态度（如信任、个人主义、长期思维）与生产力、创新和治理模式密切相关，文化适应性促进创新和韧性，而僵化传统可能限制增长。
AI.research_question: 文化信仰、价值观和社会规范如何影响不同社会的经济结果？
AI.motivation: 经济表现不能仅用制度和资源来解释，文化态度在持续发展中起着关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化经济学、社会规范理论、制度与文化互动理论。
AI.method: 基于比较国际证据的跨社会视角分析。
AI.findings: 文化取向（信任、个人主义、长期思维）与国家生产力、创新和治理模式存在显著关联；文化适应性促进创新和韧性，僵化传统限制增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 将文化视为活跃的、演化的力量，而非背景条件，强调文化在经济行为塑造中的主动作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为成功的发展战略提供指导，强调必须认识到文化作为塑造经济行为和集体繁荣的积极力量。

title: Equatorial Economies in a Warming World: Climate Challenges and Adaptive Futures
affiliations: Independent and OPGS University, India

detail.title: Equatorial Economies in a Warming World: Climate Challenges and Adaptive Futures
detail.abstract: This paper examines the unique climate-related challenges and adaptive trajectories of equatorial economies in an era of global warming. Concentrated around the Earth's midline, these nations face intensifying heat, erratic rainfall, and ecosystem stress that directly influence agriculture, health, and economic stability. The study explores how climatic variability intersects with structural vulnerabilities such as dependence on natural resources, limited industrial diversification, and demographic pressures. Drawing on comparative evidence from Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin America, it highlights the uneven capacity of equatorial states to adapt to environmental change. While some countries are advancing green infrastructure, climate-smart agriculture, and renewable energy transitions, others remain constrained by governance and resource gaps. The paper argues that sustainable futures for equatorial economies depend on integrating climate adaptation into development planning, fostering regional cooperation, and leveraging indigenous knowledge to build resilience in a warming world.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨赤道经济体在全球变暖时代面临的气候挑战和适应路径，分析了这些国家如何应对日益加剧的热浪、降雨不稳定和生态系统压力，并强调了将气候适应纳入发展规划、促进区域合作和利用本土知识的重要性。
AI.research_question: 赤道经济体在全球变暖背景下如何应对独特的气候挑战并实现适应转型？
AI.motivation: 赤道地区国家集中在地球中线，面临日益加剧的热浪、降雨不稳定和生态系统压力，这些问题直接影响农业、健康和经济稳定，需要研究其适应能力和策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候适应性理论、结构脆弱性理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 基于非洲、东南亚和拉丁美洲的比较证据分析
AI.findings: 赤道国家适应气候变化的能力不均衡，一些国家在推进绿色基础设施、气候智能农业和可再生能源转型方面取得进展，而另一些国家受制于治理和资源缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对赤道经济体气候适应轨迹的理解，提出了整合气候适应与发展规划的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为赤道国家提供了将气候适应纳入发展规划、促进区域合作和利用本土知识的具体策略，有助于构建在变暖世界中的韧性。

title: Tourism and Economic Resilience: Rethinking Growth in an Era of Global Interdependence
affiliations: Independent and University of Puerto Rico, School of Law, Students

detail.title: Tourism and Economic Resilience: Rethinking Growth in an Era of Global Interdependence
detail.abstract: This paper explores the evolving role of tourism as a driver of economic resilience in an era of increasing global interdependence. As international connectivity deepens, tourism has emerged not only as a source of income and employment but also as a mechanism for economic diversification, regional stability, and cultural exchange. Drawing on comparative evidence from both developed and developing economies, the study examines how tourism supports recovery from external shocks-such as pandemics, financial crises, and environmental disruptions-by stimulating local entrepreneurship and sustaining value chains. The analysis highlights the dual nature of tourism: while it enhances adaptive capacity and innovation, it also exposes economies to global volatility and environmental stress. The paper argues that rethinking growth through the lens of resilience requires integrating sustainability, inclusiveness, and digital transformation into tourism policy. Such an approach can position tourism as a cornerstone of balanced and future-oriented economic development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在全球互联日益加深的背景下，旅游业作为经济韧性驱动力的演变角色。研究发现旅游业不仅带来收入和就业，还通过促进创业和维持价值链来支持经济从外部冲击中恢复，但同时也使经济面临全球波动和环境压力。论文主张通过整合可持续性、包容性和数字化转型来重新思考旅游增长模式。
AI.research_question: 旅游业如何作为经济韧性驱动力在全球互联时代发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 随着国际互联性加深，旅游业在经济恢复和多样化中的重要性日益凸显，需要重新思考其在经济韧性建设中的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济韧性理论、旅游经济学、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 基于发达和发展中经济体的比较证据分析
AI.findings: 旅游业具有双重性：一方面增强适应能力和创新，另一方面使经济面临全球波动和环境压力；旅游业通过刺激本地创业和维持价值链支持经济从外部冲击中恢复。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对旅游业在经济韧性中作用的理解，提出了整合可持续性、包容性和数字化转型的旅游增长新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了将旅游业定位为平衡和面向未来经济发展基石的实践指导，强调可持续旅游政策的必要性。

title: Estimating Time-Variation in Matching Efficiency and Match Elasticity for the US Labor Market
affiliations: University of Texas at Dallas

detail.title: Estimating Time-Variation in Matching Efficiency and Match Elasticity for the US Labor Market
detail.abstract: The paper estimates time-varying matching efficiency and match elasticity within a Cobb-Douglas matching function for the U.S. non-farm sector, using a state-space model. It evaluates two specifications: (i) no constant returns to scale (CRS) with time variation (my baseline model) and (ii) CRS with time variation. We compare these two models with the standard model without time variability, and the results show significant time variation in both parameters, even under stochastic volatility. Counterfactual vacancy estimates reveal that the non-CRS baseline model fits the data best. This model suggests a gradual decline in matching efficiency, indicating growing labor market inefficiencies. Matching efficiency and match elasticity with respect to unemployment are found to be procyclical. The procyclicality in efficiency can be attributed to reduced sectoral reallocation, as seen in CPS data, driven by structural economic shifts. Procyclical match elasticity points to the nonlinear effect of labor market tightness on the job-finding rate. The paper also finds a rise in the efficient unemployment rate after COVID-19, as estimated by the baseline model.

AI.tldr: 本文使用状态空间模型估计了美国非农部门Cobb-Douglas匹配函数中的时变匹配效率和匹配弹性，发现两个参数都存在显著的时间变化，匹配效率呈下降趋势，表明劳动力市场效率恶化。
AI.research_question: 如何估计美国非农部门匹配函数中的时变参数？这些参数如何随时间变化？对劳动力市场效率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统匹配函数假设参数恒定，但实际劳动力市场条件可能随时间变化，需要更灵活的时变参数模型来准确捕捉匹配效率的动态变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cobb-Douglas匹配函数框架，引入状态空间模型来估计时变参数，比较非规模报酬不变和规模报酬不变两种设定。
AI.method: 使用状态空间模型估计时变参数，比较两种模型设定：(i)非规模报酬不变模型(基准模型)和(ii)规模报酬不变模型，并与标准恒定参数模型对比。
AI.findings: 基准模型拟合最佳，匹配效率逐渐下降，匹配效率和失业匹配弹性都具有顺周期性，COVID-19后有效失业率上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了估计匹配函数时变参数的方法，揭示了匹配效率和匹配弹性的动态特征和顺周期性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了劳动力市场效率恶化的证据，有助于理解COVID-19后劳动力市场变化，为就业政策提供参考。

title: Do Methane Mitigation Incentives Intensify Livestock Production? Evidence from California, 2016-2025
affiliations: Stanford University, Stanford University - Stanford Regulation, Evaluation, and Governance Lab (RegLab), Johns Hopkins University - Bloomberg School of Public Health, Johns Hopkins University - Bloomberg School of Public Health, Johns Hopkins University - Department of Epidemiology, Johns Hopkins University - Department of Epidemiology, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Johns Hopkins University, Stanford University - Stanford Regulation, Evaluation, and Governance Lab (RegLab) and Stanford University

detail.title: Do Methane Mitigation Incentives Intensify Livestock Production? Evidence from California, 2016-2025

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Silicon Valley Community Foundation.

detail.abstract: Public subsidies for methane mitigation infrastructure aim to combat climate change, but they may perversely incentivize polluting industries' growth. We assess biogas capture incentives in California using facility data and satellite imagery in a matched sample design. Results show incentive anticipation and receipt increases facility growth by 860 (SE 200) mature dairy cows relative to matched controls over three years, suggesting that methane reduction incentives inadvertently drive facility expansion.

AI.tldr: 加州沼气捕获激励措施虽然旨在减少甲烷排放，但反而导致奶牛场规模扩大，增加了860头成熟奶牛，表明减排激励可能适得其反地推动污染设施扩张。
AI.research_question: 沼气捕获激励措施是否会在减少甲烷排放的同时，无意中推动污染设施的增长？
AI.motivation: 公共补贴用于甲烷减排基础设施旨在应对气候变化，但可能适得其反地激励污染行业的增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境政策的经济激励理论，关注政策意外后果和道德风险问题。
AI.method: 使用设施数据和卫星影像，采用匹配样本设计评估加州沼气捕获激励措施。
AI.findings: 激励预期和接收使设施在三年内比匹配对照组多增加860头成熟奶牛，表明甲烷减排激励无意中推动了设施扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了环境政策可能产生的意外后果，挑战了单纯依靠经济激励实现环境目标的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示，需要在设计减排激励时考虑可能引发的设施扩张效应，避免适得其反的环境影响。

title: Beyond Stated Preferences: Tacit Consensus as Cultural Lock-in in Institutional Reform

detail.title: Beyond Stated Preferences: Tacit Consensus as Cultural Lock-in in Institutional Reform

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal relationships that could constitute conflicts of interest regarding this research. The author has no affiliations with labor unions, business associations, political parties, or government bodies that could influence or be perceived to influence this study. This research was conducted independently without external funding or institutional support. All data sources used are publicly available (presidential speeches, legislative records, survey data from Latinobarómetro, Poliarquía, and Universidad Torcuato Di Tella). The conceptual inspiration for "tacit consensus" comes from Alejandro Poli Gonzalvo's essay "La era del consenso tácito" (Revista Seúl, November 2025), which is appropriately cited throughout the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patients, or experimental interventions. The research analyzes publicly available secondary data (presidential speeches, legislative records, published survey results) and does not require ethics approval. No primary data collection involving human subjects was conducted. Survey data referenced in the paper (Latinobarómetro, Poliarquía, Universidad Torcuato Di Tella) were collected by third-party organizations under their own ethics protocols.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted independently by the author without financial support.

detail.abstract:
Institutional reform theories conventionally measure popular support through explicit preferences—surveys, electoral mandates, crisis urgency. Yet Argentina exhibits a paradox: 71% public support for labor flexibility reforms coexists with 0% reform success over 33 years (23 failed attempts, 1991-2024). This paper introduces cultural lock-in (CLI_cultural) as measurable constraint operating below conscious awareness, overriding stated preferences through tacit consensus.

I operationalize CLI_cultural via three behavioral indicators: (1) CT1 (narrative stability): discourse convergence across ideologically opposed governments, (2) CT2 (shock resistance): semantic invariance following exogenous crises, (3) CT3 (policy continuity): behavioral patterns unchanged despite electoral mandates.

Comparative analysis of Argentina (CLI=0.81, range 0.78-0.84), Uruguay (0.68, range 0.65-0.71), and Chile (0.45, range 0.42-0.48) demonstrates CLI_cultural aligns with reform capacity better than veto players, survey preferences, or economic crises.

In non-WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic; Henrich et al. 2010) contexts, implicit behavioral consensus systematically diverges from explicit stated preferences, producing institutional paralysis despite overwhelming reform support. 

I specify differentiated reform strategies calibrated to CLI_cultural levels: cultural erosion for high lock-in contexts (8-17 year timeline), incremental coalitions for moderate contexts, direct reform for low contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出文化锁定(CLI_cultural)概念，解释阿根廷劳动灵活性改革悖论：71%公众支持但33年23次改革尝试全部失败。通过三个行为指标测量文化锁定，发现其比传统因素更能预测改革能力，并为不同文化锁定水平提出差异化改革策略。
AI.research_question: 为什么在阿根廷等非WEIRD国家中，公众明确支持改革但改革却持续失败？
AI.motivation: 解释阿根廷劳动灵活性改革的悖论：71%公众支持但33年23次改革尝试全部失败，传统制度改革理论无法解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化锁定(CLI_cultural)理论，作为在意识层面以下运作的可测量约束，通过隐性共识超越明确偏好。
AI.method: 通过三个行为指标测量文化锁定：(1)叙事稳定性，(2)冲击抵抗力，(3)政策连续性；对阿根廷、乌拉圭和智利进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 文化锁定水平与改革能力高度相关：阿根廷(0.81)改革失败，乌拉圭(0.68)中等，智利(0.45)改革成功；文化锁定比否决者、调查偏好或经济危机更能预测改革能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出文化锁定理论，扩展制度改革理论，解释非WEIRD国家中明确偏好与隐性行为共识的系统性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同文化锁定水平制定差异化改革策略：高锁定情境采用文化侵蚀策略(8-17年时间线)，中等情境采用渐进联盟，低情境采用直接改革。

title: Evaluating Online Exercise Solution Videos Versus a Detailed Explanation in Class Using Data on Students’ Learning and Repetition Behavior
affiliations: and Munich University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Evaluating Online Exercise Solution Videos Versus a Detailed Explanation in Class Using Data on Students’ Learning and Repetition Behavior

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We conduct a field experiment to analyze whether online exercise solution videos are a valuable substitute for a detailed explanation in class. Using a Difference-in-Difference identification strategy with student time-fixed effects, we find that videos on-demand reduce students' performance significantly. Splitting our sample along class attendance shows that the results are driven by those students, who attended class. Given our detailed data on students' learning and repetition behavior we can show that only one out of four students in the treatment group watched the videos while four out of five students in the control group attended the respective class. Although we observe the typical procrastination behavior among students as the exam approaches we find no evidence that procrastination in the experiment questions compared with all other exercise questions is higher for students in the treatment group compared to the control group.

AI.tldr: 在线练习解答视频不能有效替代课堂详细讲解，反而会显著降低学生成绩，特别是对上课学生的负面影响更大。只有25%的学生观看视频，而80%的控制组学生上课。
AI.research_question: 在线练习解答视频是否能有效替代课堂详细讲解？
AI.motivation: 探索在线学习资源作为传统课堂教学替代方案的有效性
AI.theoretical_framework: 在线学习理论、替代效应理论、拖延行为理论
AI.method: 田野实验，采用双重差分识别策略和学生时间固定效应
AI.findings: 按需视频显著降低学生成绩；负面影响主要来自上课学生；只有25%治疗组学生观看视频，而80%控制组学生上课；未发现治疗组学生有更高的拖延行为
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在线资源作为课堂替代的局限性，挑战了在线学习资源普遍有效的假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构提供实证证据，建议谨慎使用在线视频完全替代课堂讲解

title: Linear Regressions with Combined Data
affiliations: Center for Research in Economics and Statistics (CREST),  and Duke University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Linear Regressions with Combined Data

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study linear regressions in a context where the outcome of interest and some of the covariates are observed in two different datasets that cannot be matched. Traditional approaches obtain point identification by relying, often implicitly, on exclusion restrictions. We show that without such restrictions, coefficients of interest can still be partially identified, with the sharp bounds taking a simple form. We obtain tighter bounds when variables observed in both datasets, but not included in the regression of interest, are available, even if these variables are not subject to specific restrictions. We develop computationally simple and asymptotically normal estimators of the bounds. Finally, we apply our methodology to estimate racial disparities in patent approval rates and to evaluate the effect of patience and risk-taking on educational performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了无法匹配的两个数据集中线性回归的识别问题，提出了在没有排除限制条件下获得部分识别的方法，并开发了计算简单且渐近正态的边界估计器。
AI.research_question: 如何在无法匹配的两个数据集中进行线性回归分析，特别是在没有排除限制条件的情况下？
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖排除限制来获得点识别，但在实际应用中这种限制往往不成立或难以验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分识别理论、线性回归模型、边界分析方法
AI.method: 开发部分识别边界方法，利用两个数据集中的共同变量来获得更紧的边界，并构建渐近正态的估计器
AI.findings: 在没有排除限制的情况下，感兴趣系数仍可被部分识别，且边界形式简单；当有共同变量时可以获得更紧的边界
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了无法匹配数据集中的线性回归识别理论，提供了不依赖排除限制的部分识别方法
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了计算简单的边界估计器，应用于专利批准率的种族差异估计以及耐心和风险承担对教育表现的影响评估

title: Critical Analysis of Applicable Legal Regulation of Plastic and Hazardous Waste in Bangladesh
affiliations: European University of Bangladesh and European University of Bangladesh

detail.title: Critical Analysis of Applicable Legal Regulation of Plastic and Hazardous Waste in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This study looks at Bangladesh's laws governing plastic and hazardous waste, emphasizing the serious risks they pose to the environment and public health. Enforcement is still lax and dispersed even though the nation was the first to outlaw thin plastic bags in 2002 and passed important legislation like the Environment Conservation Act of 1995, the Medical Waste Management Rules of 2008, and the Solid Waste Management Rules of 2021. Although there has been progress in Bangladesh's alignment with international instruments such as the Basel and Stockholm Conventions, the country remains vulnerable due to gaps in ratification, monitoring, and compliance, especially in the shipbreaking and e-waste sectors. Stronger legal responses have been pushed for by judicial activism, particularly through historic BELA cases; however, institutional flaws, corruption, and low public awareness make implementation difficult. The study also looks at the necessity of integrating informal waste workers into formal systems, the role of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), and regional cooperation under SAARC and BIMSTEC. It ends with suggestions for a thorough waste law, more robust enforcement tactics, financial rewards for environmentally friendly substitutes, and increased public involvement. For Bangladesh to achieve sustainable waste management and environmental protection, it is imperative that legal frameworks and governance capacity be strengthened.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了孟加拉国的塑料和危险废物管理法律框架，指出尽管有相关立法但执行不力，存在监管漏洞和制度缺陷，建议加强法律框架、执法策略和公众参与。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国塑料和危险废物管理法律框架的有效性及其执行挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国虽然早在2002年就禁止薄塑料袋，并制定了多项环境法规，但执法松懈分散，对环境公共健康构成严重威胁，需要系统评估法律框架的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境治理理论、法律执行理论、国际环境公约框架（巴塞尔公约、斯德哥尔摩公约）、生产者责任延伸理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、政策评估、案例研究（特别是BELA历史案例）、制度分析
AI.findings: 1. 孟加拉国法律框架存在但执行不力；2. 在船舶拆解和电子废物领域存在监管漏洞；3. 司法能动主义推动法律回应但受限于制度缺陷；4. 需要整合非正式废物工人和加强区域合作
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了发展中国家环境法律执行的理论理解，提出了法律框架与治理能力协同的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出了综合废物法律的建议；2. 提供了加强执法策略的具体方案；3. 建议将非正式废物工人纳入正式体系；4. 强调区域合作的重要性

detail.abstract: Chapter 4 of the book "Artificial Intelligence and Patents: foundations, inventorship and the Theory of Entrepreneurship", which derives from the PhD thesis of the author defended at Rio de Janeiro State University. Trough the so-called "Theory of Entrepreneurship", it aims is to provide an answer that can support future analysis of the role of patents in political and economic strategies, especially in the context of artificial intelligence as an instrument for developing inventions.

title: Understanding the Energy–Water–Socioeconomic Nexus in E-7 Economies: Evidence from a Panel QARDL Framework
affiliations: and Tokat Gaziosmanpaşa University

detail.title: Understanding the Energy–Water–Socioeconomic Nexus in E-7 Economies: Evidence from a Panel QARDL Framework
detail.abstract: This study explores the interconnections between energy consumption, water productivity, and socioeconomic factors in the E-7 economies (Brazil, China, India, Indonesia, Mexico, Russia, and Turkey) over the period 1997–2022. The research aims to identify how macroeconomic stability, demographic dynamics, and energy use jointly influence water-use efficiency within the framework of sustainable development. Using the Panel Quantile Autoregressive Distributed Lag (QARDL) model, the study captures heterogeneous and asymmetric dynamics across conditional quantiles of water productivity, allowing both short- and long-run relationships to vary by performance level. The empirical results reveal that electricity consumption exerts a consistently positive and significant effect on water productivity across all quantiles, whereas inflation and fertility have limited impacts. Economic growth and trade openness show diverse, quantile-specific patterns, reflecting structural differences among the E-7 countries. The findings confirm a stable long-run cointegration relationship among the variables. Overall, the study provides new empirical evidence that enhancing energy efficiency, promoting renewable energy, and implementing quantile-specific sustainability policies are essential to achieving balanced progress toward Sustainable Development Goals 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) and 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用面板分位数自回归分布滞后模型分析E-7经济体能源消耗、水资源生产率与社会经济因素的关联，发现电力消费对水资源生产率有持续正向影响，经济增长和贸易开放度呈现分位数特定模式，为新兴经济体实现可持续发展目标提供政策建议。
AI.research_question: 能源消耗、宏观经济稳定性和人口动态如何共同影响E-7经济体的水资源利用效率？
AI.motivation: 在可持续发展框架下，理解能源-水资源-社会经济因素的复杂互连关系，为新兴经济体实现SDG 6和SDG 7目标提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论、能源-水资源关联理论、宏观经济稳定性理论
AI.method: 面板分位数自回归分布滞后模型，分析1997-2022年E-7经济体数据
AI.findings: 电力消费对水资源生产率有持续显著正向影响；通货膨胀和生育率影响有限；经济增长和贸易开放度呈现分位数特定模式；变量间存在稳定长期协整关系
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了能源-水资源-社会经济因素互连关系的新实证证据；验证了分位数特定动态的存在；拓展了可持续发展理论在E-7经济体的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 建议提高能源效率、推广可再生能源、实施分位数特定的可持续发展政策，以平衡推进SDG 6和SDG 7目标

title: Investor Attention, Microstructure Noise and Crude Oil Market Volatility
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Investor Attention, Microstructure Noise and Crude Oil Market Volatility
detail.abstract: Geopolitical tensions, exemplified by the Russia–Ukraine conflict, have intensified uncertainty and volatility in global crude oil markets. This study develops an extended Heterogeneous Autoregressive (HAR) model to investigate the effects of investor attention and microstructure noise on crude oil market volatility, which is estimated from ultra-high-frequency data by the pre-averaging method. The empirical results demonstrate: (i) Microstructure noise drives significant in-sample short horizons volatility in both crude oil futures and fund markets but exhibits divergent predictive utility out-of-sample, enhancing forecasting accuracy for futures volatility while yielding no improvement for fund volatility. (ii) Investor attention, proxied by the Google Search Volume Index, exhibits heterogeneous effects between the crude oil fund and crude oil futures. It exerts a significant positive impact on fund volatility, while its negative effect on futures volatility remains insignificant. These findings are valuable for energy derivatives pricing, cross-market hedging strategies, and real-time monitoring of systemic risks in the commodity market.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发扩展HAR模型，分析投资者关注和微观结构噪声对原油市场波动率的影响。发现微观结构噪声在样本内显著驱动原油期货和基金市场的短期波动，但在样本外预测中仅对期货波动率有改善；投资者关注对基金波动率有显著正向影响，对期货波动率影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 投资者关注和微观结构噪声如何影响原油市场的波动率？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张局势（如俄乌冲突）加剧了全球原油市场的不确定性和波动性，需要深入理解影响原油市场波动的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的异质自回归(HAR)模型，结合投资者关注理论和市场微观结构理论。
AI.method: 使用预平均方法从超高频数据估计波动率，构建扩展HAR模型分析投资者关注（谷歌搜索量指数）和微观结构噪声的影响。
AI.findings: 微观结构噪声在样本内显著驱动原油期货和基金市场的短期波动，但在样本外预测中仅对期货波动率有改善；投资者关注对基金波动率有显著正向影响，对期货波动率影响不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了HAR模型在原油市场波动率预测中的应用，揭示了投资者关注和微观结构噪声在不同原油市场中的异质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果对能源衍生品定价、跨市场对冲策略以及商品市场系统性风险的实时监控具有重要价值。

title: Construction of a Survival Time Purchasing Power Model and Cross-National Comparative Research: A New Perspective Based on the Material Comparison Method
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Construction of a Survival Time Purchasing Power Model and Cross-National Comparative Research: A New Perspective Based on the Material Comparison Method
detail.abstract: This study aims to construct an innovative model termed "Survival Time Purchasing Power" (STPP) to quantitatively compare the real survival efficiency of minimum-income earners under different welfare regimes. The core model is: Survival Time (hours) = Benchmark Hourly Wage / ((Basic Living Cost + Risk Reserve) / 720). To address the challenge of cross-national data comparability, this study proposes the "Material Comparison Method," which assesses and selects comparable data from China, Germany, and Japan based on physical dimensions such as nutritional intake and housing conditions. Empirical calculations show that the "survival time" for Germany, Japan, and China is 14.12 hours, 8.94 hours, and 4.18 hours, respectively, indicating significant disparities. This gap primarily stems from the extent to which respective social welfare systems 分担 (share) the individual's "Risk Reserve" (measured by per capita out-of-pocket health expenditure), rather than from nominal income levels. This study not only provides a novel analytical tool for micro-level welfare comparison but also offers an effective methodological path, the "Material Comparison Method," to resolve the problem of crossnational data incomparability. The research confirms that the welfare system, through its risksharing mechanism, profoundly reshapes an individual's survival efficiency as a form of "social wage.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了"生存时间购买力"(STPP)模型来比较不同福利制度下最低收入者的真实生存效率，发现德国、日本、中国的生存时间分别为14.12小时、8.94小时和4.18小时，差距主要源于社会福利系统分担个人"风险储备"的程度而非名义收入水平。
AI.research_question: 如何定量比较不同福利制度下最低收入者的真实生存效率？
AI.motivation: 解决跨国福利比较中数据不可比性的挑战，提供微观层面的福利分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生存时间购买力(STPP)模型：生存时间(小时)=基准小时工资/((基本生活成本+风险储备)/720)；物质比较法。
AI.method: 采用物质比较法，基于营养摄入和住房条件等物理维度，从中国、德国和日本选取可比数据。
AI.findings: 德国、日本、中国的生存时间分别为14.12小时、8.94小时和4.18小时，差距主要源于社会福利系统分担个人风险储备的程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新的福利比较分析工具STPP模型，以及解决跨国数据不可比性的物质比较法。
AI.practical_contributions: 证实福利制度通过风险分担机制深刻重塑个人生存效率，作为"社会工资"的重要形式。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Innovation and The Legal Protection of AI-Generated Inventions under Current Patent Laws

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Innovation and The Legal Protection of AI-Generated Inventions under Current Patent Laws
detail.abstract: Chapter 1 of the book "Artificial Intelligence and Patents: foundations, inventorship and the Theory of Entrepreneurship", which derives from the PhD thesis of the author defended at Rio de Janeiro State University. The research seeks to contribute to the theoretical debate surrounding the legal protection of patents on inventions generated by AI, whether autonomous or not. The Chapter 1 presents a brief study of the role of artificial intelligence in the innovation ecosystem. The Financial Inclusion Strategy (2022-2025) as a driver for sustainable growth in Egypt The Financial Inclusion Strategy (2022-2025) achieves its goals from the social, economic, technological and political dimensions. According to my point of view, I believe that these goals should be expanded to achieve sustainable growth. 1- The Suggested Ecosystem Supporting Financial Inclusion in Egypt The study considers four different dimensions of the ecosystem: sociodemographic, technological, economic, and political.  
The socio-demographic sphere is a measure of the socio-demographic index, f inancial literacy, and urbanization. Initially, all three measures are chosen because of their suitability to proxy social development and being relevant for financial inclusion, GDP per capita, employment, and business freedom proxy the economic sphere of the ecosystem. Here, we can notice the political sphere, which includes government support, regulatory capacity, and electronic payments regulation

title: A General Effective-Parameter Principle for Linear PDEs with Random Coefficients
affiliations: University of the West Indies (UWI)

detail.title: A General Effective-Parameter Principle for Linear PDEs with Random Coefficients
detail.abstract: We develop a general and exact representation theorem for linear partial differential equations (PDEs) whose coefficients depend on a finite-dimensional random parameter. Under minimal assumptions---continuity of the solution with respect to the parameter and compactness/connectedness of the parameter domain---the unconditional solution of such a random-parameter PDE coincides, pointwise, with the deterministic solution evaluated at a suitable effective parameter. The result is non-asymptotic, does not rely on homogenization, ergodicity, or scale separation, and applies to linear parabolic, elliptic, hyperbolic, fractional, and integro-differential equations. We present a fully expanded introduction, an extended literature review, strengthened proofs (including functional-analytic and semigroup-based arguments), measurable selection and regularity results for the effective parameter, and explicit examples. We also relate the principle to classical stochastic homogenization, uncertainty quantification, and random operator theory.

title: Reassessing the Strength of Industrial Banks: Evidence, Trends, and Policy Implications
affiliations: University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business, University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business and Northeastern University

detail.title: Reassessing the Strength of Industrial Banks: Evidence, Trends, and Policy Implications

declarations.funderStatement: The Fintech Center at the University of Utah provided funding for the project.

detail.abstract: Industrial banks (IB) are state-chartered, FDIC-insured institutions that commercial or financial parents may own, and they occupy a distinctive niche in the U.S. banking system. We document that IBs differ from other FDIC-insured banks along three core margins: (i) ownership and supervision (CALMA/PCA commitments that contractually obligate parents to act as sources of strength), (ii) business models (specialized, often nationally distributed lending with heavy use of brokered deposits), and (iii) performance and resilience. From 2000 to 2025, we demonstrate that IBs-especially those with commercial parents-exhibit persistently higher ROA/ROE and stronger capitalization than other banks. Critically, this exists even during the Global Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 shock. IB funding relies disproportionately on (insured) brokered deposits and higher capitalization. As a result, IB failures are rare and small in aggregate relative to the broader system. IBs have niche business models that lead them to decrease market concentration and enable them to increase product innovation. Their market segments focus on specialized and underserved segments, often using information advantages from their parent company. We discuss the policy tradeoffs of layering additional regulation onto a framework in which FDIC/state oversight already mirrors that of comparable banks. We find little evidence that restrictions on commercial ownership would deliver stability benefits, but that they could increase compliance and innovation costs.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国工业银行的独特特征，发现它们与其他FDIC保险银行在所有权监管、商业模式和绩效韧性方面存在显著差异。工业银行（特别是商业母公司控股的）在2000-2025年间表现出持续更高的盈利能力和资本充足率，即使在金融危机和疫情冲击下也保持韧性。

title: Intraseasonal Variations in Time Use, Food Security, and Health Outcomes among Women in Rural Malawi ✻
affiliations: Kyoto University and Kyoto University - Graduate School of Agriculture - Division of Natural Resource Economics

detail.title: Intraseasonal Variations in Time Use, Food Security, and Health Outcomes among Women in Rural Malawi ✻
detail.abstract: The sequential nature of agriculture poses significant challenges to rural women in sub-Saharan Africa, particularly in managing health and balancing farm and domestic work across different periods of the agricultural cycle. Despite its importance, empirical evidence on these intraseasonal dynamics remains limited. This study investigates intraseasonal variations in time use, food security, and anthropometric outcomes among female caregivers in 300 farm households in rural Malawi, using panel data collected at four points during the 2022/2023 agricultural season. Results show that women's work hours increase during the lean period, reducing leisure time. Food insecurity also worsens during this period, contributing to declines in women's nutritional status, particularly as measured by mid-upper arm circumference. Fluctuations in body weight further suggest community-wide structural dynamics within the agricultural season beyond individual health, labor supply, and household food insecurity. Overall, the findings underscore the need for policies that account for within-season variation-particularly the pre-harvest hunger period-to improve food security, nutritional outcomes, and, ultimately, women's welfare in rural Malawi.

detail.title: Warehouse Optimization For U.S. Moving & Storage Companies
detail.abstract:
Warehouse Optimization for U.S. Moving & Storage Companies — Seasonality, FMCSA/DOT Compliance, WMS Playbooks, KPIs & Scalable Network Design

Transform your warehouse from the cost center to the profitable module of your network for moving and storage. This field manual shows operators, general managers and installation workers to control the reliable flow from Dock Door to Curbside Delivery without jeopardizing compliance, security or customer experience. You decode seasonality in the real world - college departures and commuting, summer booms, corporate financial cycles - right -size work for weekly hours of demand and storage, so safes, pallets and containers run with minimal touch and maximum sensitivity.

Inside step by step, they play politics into action: obtaining a SOP; Logging and marking of photographs; ABC slots with pure street geometry; climate and humidity checks; and WMS basic items corresponding to household items. Learn how to maintain capacity within the Dot lessons, go through the FMCSA audits with confidence and choose the right approach to the valuation (the value of the full value protection). Financial leaders will receive simple dashboards that break down behavior-for safe a week, dollars per one hundred pounds, requirements and CO₂ for movement-as employees and managers know exactly what it looks like.

Whether you run a single depot or a multi -stage track, the book equip you with repeatable levers: preliminary standing for July tips; SIT Economics that keeps the corridors clean; Containerized programs vs. Full-Service vs. Hybrid models; And the ways of growth in franchising, corporate branches and M&A. Each chapter is supported by control lists, templates and examples that you can scalp into days and neighborhoods.

What you learn: prognosis and employees more on real demand formulas than on average; Suggest incoming, storage and outgoing flows that minimize touches and demands; Meet the requirements of FMCSA/Dot without a reduction in permeability; Creating WMS clarity for customers, employees and finance; And watch the KPI that controls the edges, not vanity. Practical sections include permits, parking plans and windows of HOA or elevator for employees to come with certainty without having to rework. You will implement preliminary photographs and closed warnings that stop the requirements before the start, align remittances with the legal blocks of HOS and maintain the numbers of cycle and shrinking under control.

title: Informal Institutions and Global Trade: Real Effects of the Elusive
affiliations: Kwansei Gakuin University - School of Economics

detail.title: Informal Institutions and Global Trade: Real Effects of the Elusive

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Countries routinely participate in intergovernmental forums such as the G7, G20, BRICS, and MIKTA. These informal institutions—unlike formal bodies such as the EU and WTO—lack permanent administrative structures, operate through rotating presidencies, and do not issue legally binding commitments. Although often overlooked as drivers of global trade, their formation and evolution embody underlying structural shifts in the world economy. Using data for over 200 countries spanning 1994-2023, this study introduces informal institutions as a distinct determinant of trade within the gravity framework. We find that BRICS exerts trade-facilitating effects comparable to those of formal agreements such as regional trade agreements and WTO accession. This highlights a novel channel of international integration beyond legal commitments.

detail.abstract: Rainwater harvesting (RWH) has become a long-term way to deal with water shortages and encourage better water use. This study examines recent technological innovations in rainwater harvesting systems, emphasising their design, implementation, and optimisation. Smart sensors for real-time monitoring, automatic filtration systems to make sure the water is clean, and interaction with IoT platforms for data-driven administration are some of the most important new ideas. The research assesses the influence of these technologies on system efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and environmental advantages. The study uses case studies and comparative research to show how technology can make rainwater harvesting more scalable and reliable, making it a good choice for both urban and rural water supply. The results show that combining technology with other methods could help spread sustainable water conservation techniques over the world.

title: A Rationale of the PD Floor under the IRB Framework
affiliations: European Banking Authority, IRES Piemonte, Socio-Economic Research Institute of Piedmont and University of Turin

detail.title: A Rationale of the PD Floor under the IRB Framework

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Banking Authority Research Paper No. 23
publicationDetails.journalName: European Banking Authority Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The Prudential Regulation has raised the issue of estimation errors due to Internal Rating Based (IRB) estimation process that may produce underestimation of the risk measures. In the context of credit risk, lower bounds (i.e. floors) for the estimated parameters are introduced to limit the impact of such possible underestimation. These floors are heuristically justified by the difficulties to estimate the parameters when the default event becomes rare, as in the case of Low Default Probability Portfolios (LDP). In this paper, on the basis of a standard Asymptotic Single Risk Factor (ASRF) model, and by means of Monte Carlo simulations, we provide a robust justification to PD floors, and a framework for their calibration. Our results give hints that the introduction of a floor can indeed mitigate the possibility that the risk measures become less reliable.

AI.tldr: 本文基于标准ASRF模型，通过蒙特卡洛模拟为PD下限提供了稳健的理论依据和校准框架，证明引入下限确实可以降低风险度量可靠性下降的可能性。
AI.research_question: 如何为内部评级法(IRB)中的违约概率(PD)下限提供理论依据和校准框架？
AI.motivation: 监管机构关注IRB估计过程可能产生的估计误差导致风险度量低估的问题，特别是在低违约概率组合(LDP)中参数估计困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准渐近单风险因子(ASRF)模型
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟
AI.findings: 引入PD下限确实可以减轻风险度量可靠性下降的可能性
AI.theory_contributions: 为PD下限提供了稳健的理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了PD下限的校准框架

title: Internalizing Spatial-Dynamic Externalities: Endemic Disease in Chilean Aquaculture
affiliations: University of Florida, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of California, Davis and University of California

detail.title: Internalizing Spatial-Dynamic Externalities: Endemic Disease in Chilean Aquaculture
detail.abstract: Spatial-dynamic externalities are pervasive in environmental and resource systems, yet the appropriate spatial scale of policies remains poorly understood and difficult to evaluate. We study this problem in Chile's salmon aquaculture industry, where policymakers implemented a spatial management program to limit the transmission of infectious diseases. Using industry-wide panel data on veterinary outcomes and antimicrobial use, we test whether this spatially-explicit policy effectively contains pathogens by measuring spillovers across management boundaries. Exploiting policy-induced exogenous variation in pathogen prevalence, we find little evidence of disease spillover between management units and no response in antimicrobial use to pathogen pressure in neighboring units. These results suggest that Chile's spatial management policy protects against the spread of transmissible disease from one unit to another, offering rare empirical evidence on the spatial scale of management internalizing spatial-dynamic externalities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了智利三文鱼养殖业的空间管理政策，发现该政策有效控制了传染病的跨区域传播，为空间动态外部性的管理规模提供了实证证据。
AI.research_question: 智利三文鱼养殖业的空间管理政策是否能有效控制传染病的跨区域传播？
AI.motivation: 环境与资源系统中普遍存在空间动态外部性，但政策的适当空间尺度仍缺乏理解且难以评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间动态外部性理论、传染病传播理论、空间管理政策评估
AI.method: 利用智利三文鱼养殖业的全行业面板数据，包括兽医结果和抗生素使用数据，通过政策诱导的外生变异来测量管理边界间的溢出效应。
AI.findings: 发现管理单元间几乎没有疾病溢出证据，邻近单元病原体压力对抗生素使用没有显著影响，表明空间管理政策有效防止了传染病传播。
AI.theory_contributions: 为空间动态外部性的内部化管理提供了罕见的实证证据，深化了对政策空间尺度的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智利三文鱼养殖业的空间管理政策提供了有效性验证，对其他类似环境资源管理具有借鉴意义。

title: Mathematical Foundations of Explainability: A Unified Theory Across Dimensions and Domains
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Mathematical Foundations of Explainability: A Unified Theory Across Dimensions and Domains
detail.abstract: We develop a comprehensive mathematical theory of explainability that unifies fundamental limitations with domain-specific analyses. This work establishes that explainability is not a monolithic problem but varies fundamentally across three axes: (1) dimensionality-from tractable low-dimensional problems to intractable high-dimensional spaces; (2) domain structure-the mathematical properties of input/output spaces and loss functions; and (3) model architecture-from interpretable linear models to opaque deep networks with superposition. We prove fundamental impossibility results including: computational intractability of exact attribution (Theorem 2.3: Ω(2 d) complexity via formal reduction), nonuniqueness due to the Rashomon effect (Theorem 3.1), superposition-induced polysemanticity (Theorem 3.5: m/n → ∞ makes monosemantic neurons vanish with probability O(n/m), proven via sparse coding capacity arguments), and universal trade-offs between fidelity, stability, and comprehensibility (Theorem 10.1). Through rigorous domain-specific analysis of large language models, regression, classification, computer vision, reinforcement learning, time series, and financial models, we demonstrate how these limitations manifest differently across applications. Our dimensional heterogeneity analysis (Section 8) reveals that effective dimensionality-not ambient dimensionality-determines tractability, with exact methods feasible for d eff ≤ 20, approximations for 20 < d eff ≤ 100, and semantic/manifold approaches necessary for d eff > 100. Recent advances in mechanistic interpretability, particularly Anthropic's sparse autoencoder work extracting interpretable features from Claude 3 Sonnet, demonstrate partial progress but face logarithmic scaling (Conjecture 3.7) and conjectured irreducible polysemanticity. This unified framework provides rigorous foundations for future XAI research and clarifies the inevitable trade-offs in practical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统一的可解释性数学理论，揭示了可解释性在三个维度上的根本差异：维度性、领域结构和模型架构，并证明了包括计算不可行性、非唯一性和普遍权衡在内的基本不可能结果。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的可解释性数学理论来理解其在不同维度、领域和模型架构下的根本限制？
AI.motivation: 当前可解释性研究缺乏统一的理论框架，无法系统理解不同应用场景下的可解释性限制和权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于维度理论、稀疏编码理论、Rashomon效应理论和信息论的可解释性统一数学框架。
AI.method: 理论证明和数学分析，包括计算复杂性分析、概率论证明和领域特定分析。
AI.findings: 可解释性存在三个根本维度差异；证明了计算不可行性、非唯一性和普遍权衡等基本不可能结果；有效维度而非环境维度决定可处理性。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了首个统一的可解释性数学理论框架，为XAI研究提供了严格的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际部署中的可解释性权衡提供了理论指导，明确了不同维度下的适用方法范围。

title: Beyond One-Size-Fits-All: Industry-Specialized Multi-Agent Systems for Recruitment
affiliations: , Shanghai Zhongqiao Vocational and Technical University, LeapIn Group, LeapIn Group and University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: Beyond One-Size-Fits-All: Industry-Specialized Multi-Agent Systems for Recruitment
detail.abstract: AI-driven recruitment systems commonly employ general-purpose models adapted across industries, yet whether industry differences represent minor variation or structural heterogeneity requiring specialized architectures remains unclear. This study analyzes over 100,000 real interviews from eight industries using a 23-dimensional competency framework, examining heterogeneity across three levels: configuration, prioritization, and content. Results reveal substantial divergence: inter-industry competency correlations average 0.36, assessment priorities follow a universal Pareto pattern (top five = 81.7%) yet with dramatically different compositions, and only 28.2% of questions overlap. These findings demonstrate that industries operate under distinct assessment paradigms rather than shared model variants. Industry-specialized multi-agent architectures thus emerge as a structural necessity, since shared models cannot accommodate orthogonal competency structures and non-overlapping content. The three-level heterogeneity framework provides a principled basis for designing specialized AI systems and identifying when architectural rather than parametric adaptation is required.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析8个行业10万+真实面试数据发现，行业间存在显著的能力评估异质性，包括配置、优先级和内容三个层面，表明需要行业专用多智能体架构而非通用模型。
AI.research_question: 行业差异在AI驱动招聘系统中是微小变化还是需要专用架构的结构异质性？
AI.motivation: 当前AI招聘系统普遍采用跨行业通用模型，但行业差异对模型架构的影响程度尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层次异质性框架：配置异质性、优先级异质性、内容异质性
AI.method: 分析8个行业超过10万份真实面试数据，使用23维能力框架
AI.findings: 行业间能力相关性平均0.36，评估优先级遵循帕累托模式但构成差异巨大，仅有28.2%问题重叠
AI.theory_contributions: 提出三层次异质性框架，证明行业运作于不同的评估范式而非共享模型变体
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计专用AI系统提供原则基础，识别何时需要架构而非参数适应

title: Neutral Point-of-View Operational Language in Earnings Calls and Market Response
affiliations: University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: Neutral Point-of-View Operational Language in Earnings Calls and Market Response
detail.abstract: Operational performance shapes firm value, but granular operations information is rarely standardized in financial statements and is instead conveyed in narratives such as earnings calls. Prior work shows that talking more about operations in calls is associated with higher abnormal returns. This paper asks a complementary question of whether the neutral point-of-view (NPOV) of operations-related language in earnings calls is associated with stock market reactions and analyst forecasts. We use the operations-management (OM) lexicon of Voleti et al. (2025) to identify OM-related sentences in prepared remarks and Q&A, and apply a BERT-based classifier trained on Wikipedia neutrality edits to measure the NPOV of each sentence. Our main OM NPOV measures, OM_NPOV_PR and OM_NPOV_QA, are the average NPOV of OM-related sentences in the prepared remarks and management answers, respectively. We use 80,651 calls for U.S. firms from 2006-2023 and estimate fixed-effects panel regressions with rich financial and textual controls, including sentiment, readability, lexical complexity, and the incidence of OM talk. We find that higher OM_NPOV_PR is associated with higher short-window cumulative abnormal returns around the call, but not with post-call return drift. A one-standard-deviation increase in OM_NPOV_PR is associated with approximately 26 basis points higher CAR(-1, +1), and OM_NPOV_PR explains about one percent of the residual variation in CAR after controls and fixed effects. The association is concentrated in quarters with negative earnings surprises. We do not find strong evidence that OM_NPOV_PR predicts next-quarter sales growth or that it is amplified in periods with positive discretionary accruals, which weakens interpretations that rely on earnings management or private information about future-term fundamentals. On the information-environment margin, higher OM_NPOV_PR is associated with smaller analyst forecast errors when firms exhibit shorter cash conversion cycles or higher inventory turnover. Robustness checks using calibrated NPOV measures, lagged NPOV controls, and placebo tests based on financial and overall NPOV suggest that the neutral style of OM disclosures in prepared remarks captures a distinct dimension of disclosure that investors and analysts respond to in the earnings call window. Our results suggest that neutral, fact-focused OM narratives help investors and analysts process operational information when valuing earnings news.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在财报电话会议中，管理层准备好的发言部分中运营管理相关语言的客观中立程度（OM_NPOV_PR）与短期异常回报正相关，特别是在盈利不及预期的季度。这种中立风格帮助投资者和分析师更好地处理运营信息。
AI.research_question: 财报电话会议中运营管理相关语言的中立客观程度是否与股票市场反应和分析师预测相关？
AI.motivation: 运营绩效影响公司价值，但详细的运营信息很少在财务报表中标准化，而是通过财报电话会议等叙述性内容传达。现有研究表明更多讨论运营与更高异常回报相关，本文补充研究运营语言的中立性是否影响市场反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露理论和语言风格对市场反应影响的理论框架，探讨中立客观语言在信息传递中的作用。
AI.method: 使用Voleti等人（2025）的运营管理词典识别财报电话会议中与运营相关的句子，应用基于BERT的分类器测量每个句子的中立客观程度。使用2006-2023年80,651个美国公司财报电话会议数据，进行固定效应面板回归分析，控制财务和文本特征。
AI.findings: 1. 管理层准备发言中运营语言中立程度（OM_NPOV_PR）与短期异常回报正相关，一标准差增加对应约26个基点的CAR(-1,+1)增长；2. 这种关联在盈利不及预期的季度更明显；3. OM_NPOV_PR与分析师预测误差较小相关，当公司现金转换周期较短或库存周转率较高时；4. 未发现与未来季度销售增长或盈余管理的强关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了运营信息披露的中立客观风格作为信息披露的一个独特维度，补充了现有关于信息披露内容对市场影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理层提供了在财报电话会议中采用中立客观语言风格的价值证据，帮助投资者和分析师更好地评估公司运营绩效和估值。

title: Do Accounting Standards for Revenue Recognition Affect Boards' Performance Evaluation Formula?
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor - Accounting, College of Business, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) and

detail.title: Do Accounting Standards for Revenue Recognition Affect Boards' Performance Evaluation Formula?
detail.abstract: In Holmström (1979), a signal can be informative about agent efforts and yet be noisy. Using Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 606-which replaces rules-based, industry-specific revenue recognition guidelines with principles-based, contract-specific standards-we investigate how boards respond when managerial judgment can render accounting performance a more informative but noisier signal of CEO effort. Using two alternative difference-indifferences models, we consistently find that CEO pay-earnings sensitivity declines after the adoption of ASC 606. Consistent with our view that this decline is driven by increased noise in accounting performance, the effect is concentrated in revenues-the component affected by ASC 606-rather than expenses, and is more pronounced when discretionary revenues are high. The reduction in pay-earnings sensitivity is mitigated when firms have previously provided more conservative and higher-quality earnings, as well as when they disclose disaggregated revenue items. Importantly, our findings remain robust when we capture pay-earnings sensitivity using explicit, formula-based provisions in CEO compensation contracts. We further demonstrate that the decline in payearnings sensitivity mitigates subsequent earnings management, suggesting that boards' contractual adjustments help curb opportunistic reporting under ASC 606. Overall, our findings explore how boards navigate the trade-off between informativeness and noisiness of accounting performance amid rises in managerial judgment in reporting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了ASC 606会计准则实施后，董事会如何应对会计业绩作为CEO努力信号的信息含量增加但噪音也增加的情况。研究发现CEO薪酬-盈余敏感性下降，这种下降在收入（受ASC 606影响的部分）而非费用中更明显，且在可自由支配收入较高时更显著。薪酬敏感性的降低有助于抑制后续的盈余管理。
AI.research_question: 当管理层判断使会计业绩成为CEO努力更信息丰富但更嘈杂的信号时，董事会如何应对？
AI.motivation: ASC 606会计准则取代了基于规则的行业特定收入确认指南，采用基于原则的合同特定标准，增加了管理层判断，使得会计业绩作为CEO努力信号的信息含量和噪音同时增加。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Holmström (1979)的代理理论，信号在提供代理人努力信息的同时可能包含噪音。
AI.method: 使用两种替代的差异中差异模型，分析ASC 606采纳前后CEO薪酬-盈余敏感性的变化。
AI.findings: ASC 606采纳后CEO薪酬-盈余敏感性下降；这种效应集中在收入而非费用部分；在可自由支配收入较高时更明显；当企业之前提供更保守和更高质量的盈余时，以及披露分解收入项目时，敏感性下降得到缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 探索了董事会在会计业绩信息含量和噪音之间的权衡，特别是在管理层判断增加的背景下。
AI.practical_contributions: 发现薪酬合同调整有助于抑制ASC 606下的机会主义报告行为，为实务中应对会计准则变化提供了参考。

title: Aligning Night Shifts with the Chronobiological Rhythm: What Logistics Can Learn from Healthcare to Enhance Workforce Well-Being
affiliations: Dutch Healthcare Institute and HAN University of Applied Science

detail.title: Aligning Night Shifts with the Chronobiological Rhythm: What Logistics Can Learn from Healthcare to Enhance Workforce Well-Being

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no personal or financial conflicts of interest that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this research, as no patients or participants were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The logistics sector operates day and night just like the healthcare sector. This 24-hour operation ensures delivery reliability and customer satisfaction but places high demands on the employees who keep the system running. Night work is one of the greatest sources of stress in this sector, with negative consequences for health, safety and productivity. At the same time, personnel in logistics are scarce, making retention and employee wellbeing essential for continuity. In recent years the Dutch Healthcare Institute has carried out several pilots in healthcare in which night shifts were aligned more closely with the biological rhythm of employees. Different interventions were introduced to reduce the effects of night work. Recent experiments such as the one in the Jeroen Bosch Hospital show that adapting schedules to the chronobiological system leads to significantly fewer gastrointestinal complaints, less fatigue, better recovery and a likely reduction in absenteeism. This article examines what the logistics sector can learn from this approach. It shows that the human body is a powerful but often overlooked factor in the organization of labour. By designing schedules that align more closely with the biological clock, logistics can not only improve employee wellbeing but also contribute to social sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨物流行业如何借鉴医疗领域的经验，通过调整夜班排班以符合员工生物钟节律，从而改善员工健康、减少疲劳和缺勤率，提升社会可持续性。
AI.research_question: 物流行业能从医疗领域基于生物钟节律调整夜班排班的经验中学到什么？
AI.motivation: 物流行业24小时运营对员工造成巨大压力，夜班工作带来健康、安全和生产力方面的负面影响，同时行业面临人员短缺问题，员工留存和福祉对业务连续性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物钟节律理论（chronobiological system），强调人体生物钟在劳动组织中的重要性。
AI.method: 借鉴荷兰医疗机构的实验案例（如Jeroen Bosch医院的试点项目），分析医疗领域调整夜班排班的干预措施及其效果。
AI.findings: 医疗领域的实验表明，基于生物钟节律调整排班能显著减少胃肠道问题、降低疲劳感、改善恢复状况，并可能减少缺勤率。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调人体生物钟作为劳动组织中常被忽视的重要因素，为物流行业提供了基于生物节律的排班理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物流行业提供可操作的排班优化方案，通过改善员工福祉来提升社会可持续性，同时有助于解决人员短缺和留存问题。

title: Contractual Freedom and Public Policy in Syndicated Finance: A Constitutional Approach to Financial Governance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Contractual Freedom and Public Policy in Syndicated Finance: A Constitutional Approach to Financial Governance
detail.abstract:
This paper critically examines the tension between contractual freedom and the principles of public policy within the global syndicated lending market, with a specific focus on its implications for Nigerian infrastructure and finance. Syndicated loans, while vital for funding large-scale developmental projects in Nigeria, are vulnerable to opportunistic actions like "uptiering" transactions, where select lenders subordinate the debt of the remaining syndicate without their consent.

The analysis contrasts the doctrinal responses of major legal systems: New York courts prioritize textualist enforcement, offering high predictability but little protection against innovation that undermines collective trust. English courts, while theoretically allowing a check on discretionary powers (the Braganza principle), remain deeply cautious. The paper argues that Nigerian law, characterized by its strict "sacrosanct" view of contract and absence of robust good faith doctrines, creates a constitutional vacuum where the loan agreement itself becomes the sole source of governance.

To mitigate "lender-on-lender violence" and protect the integrity of the collective investment, the paper proposes a "constitutional design" framework for syndicated finance. This framework is built upon four core principles: Anti-Subordination (requiring unanimous consent for seniority loss), Anti-Conflict Voting (excluding conflicted parties from amendment votes), Carve-Out Integrity, and Rational Discretion. By elevating these safeguards from mere contractual clauses to an explicit constitutional order of private law, the paper argues for a more stable and just market architecture that sustains both development and fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了全球银团贷款市场中契约自由与公共政策原则之间的紧张关系，特别关注其对尼日利亚基础设施和金融的影响。通过对比纽约和英国法院的不同司法回应，指出尼日利亚法律存在治理真空，并提出基于四大核心原则的"宪法设计"框架来保护集体投资的完整性。
AI.research_question: 如何在全球银团贷款市场中平衡契约自由与公共政策原则，特别是在尼日利亚基础设施融资背景下防止"层级提升"等机会主义行为？
AI.motivation: 银团贷款对尼日利亚大型发展项目融资至关重要，但容易受到"层级提升"等机会主义行为的侵害，其中部分贷款人未经其他银团成员同意就将其债务次级化，破坏了集体信任和市场完整性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 契约自由理论、公共政策原则、宪法设计框架、私人法律秩序理论
AI.method: 比较法分析（对比纽约和英国法院的司法回应）、理论分析、制度设计
AI.findings: 纽约法院优先文本主义执行，提供高可预测性但缺乏对创新的保护；英国法院理论上允许对自由裁量权进行审查但保持谨慎；尼日利亚法律存在治理真空，贷款协议成为唯一治理来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"宪法设计"理论框架，将保护措施从单纯的合同条款提升为明确的私人法律宪法秩序，为银团金融提供更稳定的市场架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及类似法域的银团贷款实践提供了具体的制度设计建议，包括反次级化、反冲突投票、隔离完整性和合理裁量权四大原则，有助于防止"贷款人之间的暴力"和保护集体投资。

title: The Trust Premium

detail.title: The Trust Premium
detail.abstract: I develop a game-theoretic equilibrium model that microfounds trust as an equilibrium selection mechanism in asset markets. I analyze a repeated Prisoner's Dilemma among investors where trust evolves endogenously through Bayesian updating of beliefs about counterparty types. The model generates multiple Markov Perfect Equilibria: a high-trust cooperative equilibrium with low strategic risk premia, and a low-trust defective equilibrium with elevated discount rates. My central contribution is to formalize how transient coordination failures can trigger self-reinforcing trust decay that propagates through asset prices via an augmented stochastic discount factor. The framework provides microfoundations for trust as a fundamental determinant of financial valuations, independent of cash flow dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个博弈论均衡模型，将信任作为资产市场中的均衡选择机制。通过贝叶斯更新的信念演化，模型产生了多重马尔可夫完美均衡：高信任合作均衡和低信任背叛均衡。主要贡献是形式化了短暂协调失败如何引发自我强化的信任衰减，并通过增强的随机贴现因子传播到资产价格中。
AI.research_question: 信任如何作为均衡选择机制影响资产市场？短暂协调失败如何引发自我强化的信任衰减并传播到资产价格中？
AI.motivation: 为信任作为金融估值的基本决定因素提供微观基础，独立于现金流动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论均衡模型、重复囚徒困境、贝叶斯信念更新、马尔可夫完美均衡、随机贴现因子理论
AI.method: 开发理论模型，分析重复囚徒困境中投资者的行为，其中信任通过贝叶斯更新关于对手方类型的信念内生演化
AI.findings: 模型产生多重均衡：高信任合作均衡（低战略风险溢价）和低信任背叛均衡（高贴现率）。短暂协调失败可触发自我强化的信任衰减，通过增强的随机贴现因子影响资产价格。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信任作为资产市场均衡选择机制提供微观基础；形式化了信任衰减的传播机制；将信任确立为独立于现金流的金融估值基本决定因素
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了市场信任崩溃如何自我强化并影响资产价格；为理解金融危机的信任动态提供了理论框架；对风险管理和资产定价具有启示意义

title: CBDC Stress Test in a Dual-Currency Setting

detail.title: CBDC Stress Test in a Dual-Currency Setting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interests.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding received.

detail.abstract:
This study explores the potential impact of introducing a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) on financial stability in an emerging dual-currency economy – Romania, where the domestic currency (RON) coexists with the euro. It develops an integrated analytical framework combining econometrics, machine learning, and behavioural modelling. CBDC adoption probabilities are estimated using XGBoost and logistic regression models trained on behavioural and macro-financial indicators rather than survey data. Liquidity stress simulations assess how banks would respond to deposit withdrawals resulting from CBDC adoption, while VAR, MSVAR, and SVAR models capture the macro-financial transmission of liquidity shocks into credit contraction and changes in monetary conditions.

The findings indicate that CBDC uptake (co-circulating Digital RON and Digital EUR) would be moderate at issuance, amounting to around EUR 1 billion, primarily driven by digital readiness and trust in the central bank. A one-point increase in digital trust raises the likelihood of adoption by approximately 12%. Liquidity simulations show that under a holding cap of RON 7,500 (about EUR 1,500 for the scenario where Digital RON and Digital EUR co-circulate), over 60% of banks could absorb deposit withdrawals without significant stress, selling less than a quarter of their securities portfolios. Beyond RON 15,000, however, nearly 40% of banks would face deposit outflows exceeding 10% of total liabilities, necessitating large-scale asset sales and wholesale funding. Every RON 1 billion in deposit withdrawals is associated with a 0.7–1 – 1.1% decline in credit portfolios. Nonetheless, even in adverse scenarios, the maximum overall liquidity cost to the banking system remains manageable at around RON 2 billion over a decade.

The study concludes that a non-remunerated, capped CBDC – designed primarily as a means of payment rather than a store of value – can be introduced without compromising financial stability. In dual-currency economies, differentiated holding limits for domestic and foreign digital currencies (e.g., Digital RON versus Digital Euro) are crucial to prevent uncontrolled euroisation and preserve monetary sovereignty. A prudent design with moderate caps, non-remuneration, and macroprudential coordination can transform CBDC into a digital liquidity buffer and a complementary monetary policy instrument that enhances resilience and inclusion rather than destabilising the financial system.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在罗马尼亚这个新兴双货币经济体中引入央行数字货币(CBDC)对金融稳定的潜在影响。研究发现，设计合理的CBDC（非计息、有持有上限、主要作为支付工具而非价值储存）可以在不损害金融稳定的情况下引入，在双货币经济体中需对本国和外国数字货币设置差异化持有上限。
AI.research_question: 在罗马尼亚这样的新兴双货币经济体中引入央行数字货币(CBDC)会对金融稳定产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 探索在双货币经济体（罗马尼亚列伊与欧元共存）中引入CBDC的可行性及其对金融稳定的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合计量经济学、机器学习和行为建模的分析框架，结合流动性压力测试和宏观金融传导机制。
AI.method: 使用XGBoost和逻辑回归模型估计CBDC采用概率，通过流动性压力模拟评估银行应对存款提取的能力，采用VAR、MSVAR和SVAR模型分析流动性冲击的宏观金融传导。
AI.findings: CBDC采用规模初期约10亿欧元，主要受数字准备度和对央行信任度驱动；在7500列伊持有上限下，60%以上银行可无显著压力吸收存款提取；超过15000列伊时，40%银行面临超过总负债10%的存款外流；每10亿列伊存款提取导致信贷组合下降0.7-1.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为双货币经济体CBDC设计提供了理论框架，强调差异化持有上限对防止非控制性欧元化和维护货币主权的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了CBDC设计的实用建议：非计息、适度持有上限、宏观审慎协调，可将CBDC转化为数字流动性缓冲和补充性货币政策工具，增强金融系统韧性和包容性。

title: A Three-Point Model of Reference-Dependent Satisfaction: Integrating Expectations, Opportunity Costs, and Upside Surprises
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Three-Point Model of Reference-Dependent Satisfaction: Integrating Expectations, Opportunity Costs, and Upside Surprises
detail.abstract: We develop a formal model of reference-dependent satisfaction that extends Prospect Theory and expectations-based reference points by introducing three independent reference points: Satisfaction Potential (PS), Base Point (PB), and Dissatisfaction Potential (PI). Unlike existing models that treat satisfaction and dissatisfaction symmetrically through a single value function, we demonstrate that these are fundamentally distinct psychological mechanisms with separate dynamics. Our key innovation is the explicit incorporation of opportunity costs into the reference structure: the value of alternatives not chosen (V₂) shifts the dissatisfaction potential independently of satisfaction potential, weighted by the probability those alternatives would have succeeded (P₂). We prove that the ratio of dissatisfaction to satisfaction (r = I/S) diverges to infinity as subjective probability of success approaches certainty, formalizing why overconfidence creates extreme emotional vulnerability. The model generates novel predictions about decision-making under uncertainty in one-shot decisions, explains classical findings in behavioral economics, and provides a mathematical foundation for wisdom traditions emphasizing "detachment" and managing expectations. We propose five testable predictions and discuss applications to therapy, performance anxiety, and relationship dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于三个独立参考点的形式化满意度模型，扩展了前景理论和期望参考点理论。模型引入机会成本到参考结构中，证明满意和不满意是独立心理机制，并形式化了过度自信导致情绪脆弱性的数学原理。
AI.research_question: 如何形式化建模满意度和不满意度的不对称心理机制？机会成本在参考点形成中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有模型将满意和不满意视为对称的价值函数，但心理学证据表明它们是独立机制。需要更准确的形式化模型来解释决策中的情绪动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前景理论、期望参考点理论、机会成本理论、心理学中的满意-不满意不对称机制
AI.method: 形式化建模方法，构建包含三个参考点（满意度潜力、基准点、不满意潜力）的数学模型，并进行数学证明
AI.findings: 满意和不满意是独立心理机制；机会成本通过未选择替代方案的价值影响不满意潜力；不满意与满意度的比率在成功概率趋近1时发散到无穷大
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了前景理论，引入三个独立参考点；形式化了满意-不满意不对称机制；建立了过度自信与情绪脆弱性的数学联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为治疗、表现焦虑和关系动态提供理论基础；提出五个可检验预测；为智慧传统中的"超脱"概念提供数学基础

title: AI Salience and the Cost of Equity Capital
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE) and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE)

detail.title: AI Salience and the Cost of Equity Capital
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between Artificial Intelligence (AI) salience and the cost of equity capital (COE). We innovatively decompose the AI disclosure during earnings conference calls into two parts: the materialised component: AI capability and the unmaterialised component: AI salience. Utilizing a theoretical framework grounded in game theory, we explore how firms can strategically manipulate AI salience to influence investor perceptions and financing costs. The model predicts that while AI salience can lower the COE by reducing investor uncertainty, it can also increase disclosure noise, leading to a non-monotonic relationship between AI salience and cost of equity. We empirically test this model using earnings conference call transcripts and implied COE data from U.S. firms over the period 2002-2021. Our results indicate that AI salience is negatively correlated with COE, suggesting that firms with higher AI salience enjoy lower financing costs. Furthermore, we demonstrate that institutional ownership and market attention moderate this relationship, with the effect being more pronounced in firms with weak governance and imperfect market competition. The findings highlight the strategic role of AI salience in corporate financing, offering new insights for both investors and regulators in understanding the financial implications of AI disclosures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现AI显著性（AI salience）与股权资本成本（COE）呈负相关关系，即AI显著性越高的公司融资成本越低。该关系受到机构持股和市场关注度的调节，在治理薄弱和市场竞争不完全的公司中更为显著。
AI.research_question: AI显著性如何影响股权资本成本？
AI.motivation: 探讨企业如何通过战略性地操纵AI显著性来影响投资者认知和融资成本，填补AI披露与融资成本关系的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论的理论框架，分析AI显著性如何通过降低投资者不确定性和增加披露噪音来影响股权资本成本。
AI.method: 使用2002-2021年美国公司盈利电话会议记录和隐含股权资本成本数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: AI显著性与股权资本成本呈负相关；机构持股和市场关注度调节这一关系；在治理薄弱和市场竞争不完全的公司中效应更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI显著性影响融资成本的理论模型，揭示了非单调关系机制，丰富了AI披露理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供通过AI披露策略降低融资成本的实践指导，为投资者和监管机构理解AI披露的财务影响提供新视角。

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. The research and analysis presented in this paper were conducted independently, without any external influence or bias from institutions, companies, or financial sponsors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study does not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental interventions requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no external funding. It was self-funded and developed as part of the author’s independent research into financial modeling and institutional development frameworks.

contentType.other: Applied Research Paper (Financial Modeling & Institutional Land Development)

detail.abstract: This paper develops a modular financial-modeling framework for large-scale institutional land development in emerging markets, applied to India's education infrastructure sector. Using a 100-acre integrated education hub prototype, the study demonstrates how K-12 schools, universities, medical colleges, residential facilities, and shared infrastructure can be structured within a unified yet flexible financial ecosystem. The framework introduces a CapEx-FAR-Revenue linkage model integrating physical metrics with financial performance drivers, combining entity-wise P&L segmentation, shared-service cost allocation, and dynamic CapEx phasing. Findings show integrated ecosystems achieve 22-25% higher NPV and 3-5 percentage-point IRR uplift versus standalone institutions when supported by shared services and phased development. The Shared-Infrastructure Elasticity Index (SIEI) of 0.153 quantifies that each 1% increase in shared infrastructure investment yields 0.15 pp IRR improvement. For investors, the framework reframes education infrastructure as a predictable quasi-infrastructure asset class; for policymakers, it demonstrates how land-use regulations function as de facto industrial policy.

AI.tldr: 本文为新兴市场大规模机构土地开发构建了一个模块化金融建模框架，应用于印度教育基础设施领域。通过100英亩综合教育中心原型，展示了K-12学校、大学、医学院、住宅设施和共享基础设施如何在统一但灵活的金融生态系统中构建。该框架引入了CapEx-FAR-收入联动模型，将物理指标与财务绩效驱动因素整合，结合实体层面的损益分割、共享服务成本分配和动态资本支出分阶段。研究发现，在共享服务和分阶段开发支持下，综合生态系统比独立机构实现22-25%更高的净现值和3-5个百分点的内部收益率提升。
AI.research_question: 如何为新兴市场大规模机构土地开发构建有效的金融建模框架，特别是在教育基础设施领域？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场教育基础设施投资需求增长，但缺乏系统化的金融建模方法，需要开发能够整合多种教育设施的统一金融框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: CapEx-FAR-收入联动模型，将物理指标（如容积率）与财务绩效驱动因素整合；实体层面损益分割；共享服务成本分配理论；动态资本支出分阶段理论。
AI.method: 采用模块化金融建模方法，基于100英亩综合教育中心原型进行案例研究，结合实体层面P&L分割、共享服务成本分配和动态CapEx分阶段分析。
AI.findings: 综合生态系统比独立机构实现22-25%更高的净现值和3-5个百分点的内部收益率提升；共享基础设施弹性指数(SIEI)为0.153，表明共享基础设施投资每增加1%可带来0.15个百分点的IRR改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了CapEx-FAR-收入联动模型，将物理规划指标与财务绩效系统整合；提出了共享基础设施弹性指数(SIEI)量化共享投资效益；建立了教育基础设施作为准基础设施资产类别的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了将教育基础设施重新定义为可预测的准基础设施资产类别的框架；为政策制定者展示了土地使用法规如何作为事实上的产业政策工具；提供了可应用于其他新兴市场的模块化金融建模方法。

title: APPLICATION OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLI-GENCE IN CORPORATE RISK MANAGE-MENT
affiliations: The Russian Presidental Academy of National Economy and Public Administration, Noth-West Institute of Management, Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration North-West Institute of Management: Saint-Petersburg, RU and Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration North-West Institute of Management: Saint-Petersburg, RU

detail.title: APPLICATION OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLI-GENCE IN CORPORATE RISK MANAGE-MENT
detail.abstract: In the context of the struggle for technologi-cal superiority, artificial intelligence is be-coming one of the key tools for achieving leading positions. At the same time, scien-tists are engaged in a heated discussion about the feasibility of its use in many areas of our lives and the threats of degradation of human qualities that distinguish them from other representatives of the living world. At the same time, there is an area where the use of this tool is very beneficial, and its dominance over human abilities in this area is beyond doubt. This area includes financial management, or more precisely, the as-sessment and management of risks in the company's activities. Artificial intelligence has already found wide application in risk management in financial intermediation. However, in the real sector, especially in the processing industry, shipbuilding, automobile manufacturing and certain heavy equipment, its use in risk management is only on the agenda. The purpose of the scientific work was to propose approaches to the further development of methods for using genera-tive intelligence to assess and manage risks based on an analysis of the experience of using artificial intelligence in financial man-agement. To do this, the authors updated information on typical risks in financial man-agement, studied the ways of using artificial intelligence to work with these risks, as-sessed its impact on the quality of financial risk management of companies using practi-cal examples, identified the strengths and weaknesses of this approach, and as a re-sult developed recommendations for the further development of the corporate financial management system. The article is of inter-est to practicing economists who are improv-ing approaches to the use of artificial intelli-gence in their organizations, as well as those involved in planning and determining busi-ness development vectors for the near fu-ture. In particular, the authors provide rec-ommendations for overcoming the key prob-lems of introducing artificial intelligence into company risk management, and also em-phasize strategic approaches to its applica-tion, and not just as a technological tool in the current analysis, which is a novelty for published studies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了生成式人工智能在财务风险管理中的应用，分析了AI在金融中介领域的成功经验，并提出了将AI应用于实体经济（如制造业、造船业等）风险管理的具体方法和发展建议。
AI.research_question: 如何利用生成式人工智能来评估和管理公司风险？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在金融中介领域的风险管理中已广泛应用，但在实体经济部门的应用仍处于起步阶段，需要开发更有效的方法来利用AI进行风险评估和管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工智能在金融风险管理中的理论基础，结合生成式AI的特性，构建适用于实体经济部门的AI风险管理框架。
AI.method: 作者更新了财务管理中的典型风险信息，研究了AI处理这些风险的方法，通过实际案例评估了AI对公司财务风险管理质量的影响，识别了该方法的优缺点，并最终提出了改进建议。
AI.findings: AI在财务风险管理中具有显著优势，但也存在一些局限性；文章提供了克服AI引入问题的具体建议，并强调战略性的应用方法而非仅作为技术工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将生成式AI应用于实体经济风险管理的理论框架，强调从技术工具到战略方法的转变，为相关研究提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践经济学家提供了具体的AI应用建议，包括如何克服引入障碍和战略性地应用AI进行风险管理，对企业的近期发展规划具有实际指导意义。
